posts.content_html_raw:
I finally caught up with the thread. You guys are fire when it comes to keeping the discussions going and posting funny troll posts and KK renders.

Especially since I actually did not expect this update to be really that remarkable. Given that this was to be mostly about the invite over events of several girls, which initially gave me "filler" update vibes, it turned out to be quite diverse and weirdly wholesome a lot of the time.

Anyways, here's my two cents:
I already gave my first impressions in form of meme reaction images in my earlier post from when the update just dropped here, but I just want to stress once more, this time with words, how much it pained me that we were teased with some possible action between Rin and Akira Sensei Akira, to have the rug pulled back last second in dramatic fashion.
And as horny as I was for that to happen, as Rin is an S tier character in mine and many others' books, I also just wanted to have their relationship progress that way. To basically "get it over with", as the released tension between them might unlock even deeper connections between them, since I am convinced that they do fit each other (relatively speaking of course, in the context of their world, dear officers).

And, apparently opposed to a few others here, I would not be happy to see a Rokuhara threesome. Rin deserves her own very intimate encounter with Akira at this point. And even though back when we were presented with a choice for a Chika + x threesome, I immediately hammered the mouse on the Rin button, nowadays I would actually probably not enjoy it that much. As I indicated in my previous post, I think having Chika involved feels wrong. Sel provided a reasonable angle through which Chika sees the situation, but I think that it undermines Rin's true feelings and you could tell during the encounter.

Tl;dr: Rin is amazing and I hope she gets some love from Akira in all forms (fatherly, platonically and the silverback gorilla kind).
Sana is a lil' freak and I'm here for it. And it kind of fills me with a weird sense of pride to see her develop from a shy and awkward little wallflower to a conniving little devil that tricks her teacher's gf into leaving the two og them alone for just enough time to have him take her virginity. Even Akira was surprised to see that she is capable of such cunning and deprived behavior.

And the whole thing with the cumming inside part - thank you Sana for being sane enough to be irritated by that. That was a nice touch to her being still very much aware of what they are doing and that while she is trying to satiate her inner desires, she is not naive enough to let Akira get away with things like that out of convenience.

One thing that made me wonder though is why she appeared as adult Sana to him briefly. Is it a mere "flashback" to the reset puzzle? I don't think he usually gets those at all. Or is it a genuine flash forward and Akira actually does suffer a mental breakdown to the point that he is vegetating in his apartment (i.e. the future consequences of the dark route?) for adult Sana to keep him company occasionally, which in turn gets abstractedly recreated by his past self during the reset? This might be a stretch, just found it odd.



Niki really is long overdue to swallow the red pill. I wonder how she will react.
I saw this topic discussed only briefly, though I feel like this was a more major revelation then a lot of people seem to make of it.
The whole scene (even on the good uncle path on which I am on in my current run) screams of Ami Prime and her being very much omniscient. She admits to know what Akira has been doing with all the girls (Ami: "He does way worse shit all the time.") and especially in this line:
This is just blatantly admitting that she is in full control of the situation, fully aware that during other timelines Akira fucks her daily, but still being fairly okay with it, insinuating that she has a bigger plan in mind that is quite obviously more important than having her Dad fuck her, which says a lot since this is Ami.

Which, again, begs the age old question of when she transitioned from being the relatively pure and unknowing Ami to being Ami Prime. Which at this point, I'm not sure if this is a when-question or rather an if-question.
Right at this point of the scene, I had to save and quit. I'm usually not really that suspectable to emotional scenes most of the time, but somehow this whole flashback made me sad and angry enough to rage quit in order to not spoil my whole mood for the day.

Io is a gem and seeing that she crossed paths with Yasu in the distant past, albeit briefly, gives some openings for a potential connection between the two in the future. After all, the two of them might actually have the most in common when it comes to the specific childhood trauma they had to endure.
Luckily the following Io events were much more wholesome. Which also brings me too...
I love Uta. Another S rank character that got a bit of unexpected spotlight this update. (Really looking forward to 0.49 though)
First off, after last update's Touka reaction, this is another top tier facial expression:
And I know that Akira was mostly just talking out of his ass as usual here, but this was still heartwarming:

As other have also finally noticed apparently, Uta is a complex and weirdly mature character, which seems contradictory at first, since she is so emotional, undecisive and hormonal. But unlike a Kirin or even an Ayane, she seems much more in control of her feelings, hormones and urges, even if the underlying reasons might have more to do with her own problems than maturity per se. Still, I feel like she is very smart and has a heart of gold. I'm glad Io has her as her best friend, they complete each other well.

But I dread the day on which Akira fucks this up, I will probably have to go on vacation to Nara and pet some deer fawn to heal myself from the inevitable heart break.
Everything that happened with Chika this update was a surprise to me. Starting from her getting freaky with Rin, which still felt wrong but she also kind of made sense from her perspective, to the conversation she had with Akira, to the absolute wild ride that was the TSS.
I think others have already discussed the same points I would make, so I won't repeat it. Though I'm not as super convinced as others that the final implication really was that Chika whored herself out to eldritch beings for 19 years to return to Chinami. I guess it was all much more allegorical and I assume this will make more sense with further context from future scenes.

One thing I just wanted to point out was a sentence from Akira's inner monologue that stood out to me:

I get what Akira means by that, but to me it almost sounds more like something a victim of a toxic relationship would say to explain their reasoning to stay with said partner. "Yeah well, she is fucked in the head right now and I am lowkey scared of her, but hey, nobody is perfect and I am an even worse piece of shit, so I should be grateful and let it slide" ??? Maybe it's just me that found this line icky though.
I just wish Akira would finally grow up and deal with his problems head on for once. He is getting better, but scenes like these make me think that he will have to cause a huge deal of suffering first for anything to truly change. Which of course is already written on the wall with huge letters, with the dark route waiting for us. Sigh.
Huge earnings for Osako stock owners this month. She has skyrocketed in my rankings for sure.
She is basically becoming Akira's best buddy in record time. By which I mean that she is exactly what he needs right now. Someone who he can vent to, speak out the unspeakable. Even though he himself admits that it did not feel freeing, in the long run it's much healthier to confide with someone on your inner turmoil than to have it gnaw at you and eat you from the inside. And Osako is surprisingly approachable and understanding in all this. I would have never thought for this to be possible in the past, which she also brought up. To me, this has almost similar implications as him realizing his name is Akira. It should make it easier for him to accept who he truly is. That there are people that outright call him what he is, a predator (minus Yumi who did it in a Tsundere way). I really look forward to their future interactions.

Also, maybe I'm the only one, but reading this one felt like it hit a bit too close to home for me personally. And I hate having to identify with Akira, but man, don't we all have our own personal struggles?
Some top notch writing in this update. I am very satisfied. Hope the trend continues in the next one.

spoilers.title: R.I.N. (Regretfully Improbable Nookie)
spoilers.html:
I already gave my first impressions in form of meme reaction images in my earlier post from when the update just dropped here, but I just want to stress once more, this time with words, how much it pained me that we were teased with some possible action between Rin and Akira Sensei Akira, to have the rug pulled back last second in dramatic fashion.
And as horny as I was for that to happen, as Rin is an S tier character in mine and many others' books, I also just wanted to have their relationship progress that way. To basically "get it over with", as the released tension between them might unlock even deeper connections between them, since I am convinced that they do fit each other (relatively speaking of course, in the context of their world, dear officers).

And, apparently opposed to a few others here, I would not be happy to see a Rokuhara threesome. Rin deserves her own very intimate encounter with Akira at this point. And even though back when we were presented with a choice for a Chika + x threesome, I immediately hammered the mouse on the Rin button, nowadays I would actually probably not enjoy it that much. As I indicated in my previous post, I think having Chika involved feels wrong. Sel provided a reasonable angle through which Chika sees the situation, but I think that it undermines Rin's true feelings and you could tell during the encounter.

Tl;dr: Rin is amazing and I hope she gets some love from Akira in all forms (fatherly, platonically and the silverback gorilla kind).

spoilers.html:
Sana is a lil' freak and I'm here for it. And it kind of fills me with a weird sense of pride to see her develop from a shy and awkward little wallflower to a conniving little devil that tricks her teacher's gf into leaving the two og them alone for just enough time to have him take her virginity. Even Akira was surprised to see that she is capable of such cunning and deprived behavior.

And the whole thing with the cumming inside part - thank you Sana for being sane enough to be irritated by that. That was a nice touch to her being still very much aware of what they are doing and that while she is trying to satiate her inner desires, she is not naive enough to let Akira get away with things like that out of convenience.

One thing that made me wonder though is why she appeared as adult Sana to him briefly. Is it a mere "flashback" to the reset puzzle? I don't think he usually gets those at all. Or is it a genuine flash forward and Akira actually does suffer a mental breakdown to the point that he is vegetating in his apartment (i.e. the future consequences of the dark route?) for adult Sana to keep him company occasionally, which in turn gets abstractedly recreated by his past self during the reset? This might be a stretch, just found it odd.

This is just blatantly admitting that she is in full control of the situation, fully aware that during other timelines Akira fucks her daily, but still being fairly okay with it, insinuating that she has a bigger plan in mind that is quite obviously more important than having her Dad fuck her, which says a lot since this is Ami.

Which, again, begs the age old question of when she transitioned from being the relatively pure and unknowing Ami to being Ami Prime. Which at this point, I'm not sure if this is a when-question or rather an if-question.

spoilers.title: Chika
spoilers.html:
Everything that happened with Chika this update was a surprise to me. Starting from her getting freaky with Rin, which still felt wrong but she also kind of made sense from her perspective, to the conversation she had with Akira, to the absolute wild ride that was the TSS.
I think others have already discussed the same points I would make, so I won't repeat it. Though I'm not as super convinced as others that the final implication really was that Chika whored herself out to eldritch beings for 19 years to return to Chinami. I guess it was all much more allegorical and I assume this will make more sense with further context from future scenes.

One thing I just wanted to point out was a sentence from Akira's inner monologue that stood out to me:

I get what Akira means by that, but to me it almost sounds more like something a victim of a toxic relationship would say to explain their reasoning to stay with said partner. "Yeah well, she is fucked in the head right now and I am lowkey scared of her, but hey, nobody is perfect and I am an even worse piece of shit, so I should be grateful and let it slide" ??? Maybe it's just me that found this line icky though.
I just wish Akira would finally grow up and deal with his problems head on for once. He is getting better, but scenes like these make me think that he will have to cause a huge deal of suffering first for anything to truly change. Which of course is already written on the wall with huge letters, with the dark route waiting for us. Sigh.

spoilers.title: Chika
spoilers.html:
Everything that happened with Chika this update was a surprise to me. Starting from her getting freaky with Rin, which still felt wrong but she also kind of made sense from her perspective, to the conversation she had with Akira, to the absolute wild ride that was the TSS.
I think others have already discussed the same points I would make, so I won't repeat it. Though I'm not as super convinced as others that the final implication really was that Chika whored herself out to eldritch beings for 19 years to return to Chinami. I guess it was all much more allegorical and I assume this will make more sense with further context from future scenes.

One thing I just wanted to point out was a sentence from Akira's inner monologue that stood out to me:
View attachment 4534265
I get what Akira means by that, but to me it almost sounds more like something a victim of a toxic relationship would say to explain their reasoning to stay with said partner. "Yeah well, she is fucked in the head right now and I am lowkey scared of her, but hey, nobody is perfect and I am an even worse piece of shit, so I should be grateful and let it slide" ??? Maybe it's just me that found this line icky though.
I just wish Akira would finally grow up and deal with his problems head on for once. He is getting better, but scenes like these make me think that he will have to cause a huge deal of suffering first for anything to truly change. Which of course is already written on the wall with huge letters, with the dark route waiting for us. Sigh.

spoilers.title: Osako is a real one
spoilers.html:
Huge earnings for Osako stock owners this month. She has skyrocketed in my rankings for sure.
She is basically becoming Akira's best buddy in record time. By which I mean that she is exactly what he needs right now. Someone who he can vent to, speak out the unspeakable. Even though he himself admits that it did not feel freeing, in the long run it's much healthier to confide with someone on your inner turmoil than to have it gnaw at you and eat you from the inside. And Osako is surprisingly approachable and understanding in all this. I would have never thought for this to be possible in the past, which she also brought up. To me, this has almost similar implications as him realizing his name is Akira. It should make it easier for him to accept who he truly is. That there are people that outright call him what he is, a predator (minus Yumi who did it in a Tsundere way). I really look forward to their future interactions.

Also, maybe I'm the only one, but reading this one felt like it hit a bit too close to home for me personally. And I hate having to identify with Akira, but man, don't we all have our own personal struggles?

Day 57 character count 11381.
Wakana's catch phrase is back! Yippiiiii!

Okay, mc. I don't know what your deal is here. Like 99% of the time you have said you want to talk about others and not yourself and you don't want to open up, recently you have started opening up to people and now you say that 99% of the time you want to talk about yourself. Fuck off with that bullshit and choose a direction.

I'm starting to wonder if I've been led astray in my assumptions about whether this is or is not a sex focused game. At the start, I assumed it wasn't, then as I kept playing I switched stance to that it is and now it feels like it's shifting back to that it isn't. It feels like the mc wants a friendship with Imani and nothing more under the thought that Niki is better for him or something, which I definitely don't like. I keep going right back my thought process that it should be okay to declare that you are sex positive but aren't looking for a romantic or love based relationship. So friends with benefits and preferably non exclusivity.

He's friend zoning Imani because she's too good for me... It's the kind of insult that makes you think you are cursed through being too blessed or something. People who are in a position way above your own, who are too attractive and so on. Like what I hear about girls who are so attractive that nobody bothers approaching them and thus those girls remain single because everyone else either has too low self-esteem to say yes or nobody bothers to even approach them. What he's saying is that she's a really good friend he doesn't want to lose by getting into a relationship. I don't really get it but apparently it's super common for the friends who end up hooking up to eventually lose both that relationship and their friendship and many in positions of great friendship are afraid asking the other out, the other may be afraid of being asked out and so on.

Not the ideal time for Yumi to show up... Of course she had to show up when Imani wanted to ask him for "friend-sex"... Damnit Yumi.
If Yumi hadn't shown up there, would they have done it?

I feel like this is gonna be something similar to Molly where the world FORCES them into sexual positions because the mc tries to stay away from it.

Man, this fucking sucks! This must happen a lot in good relationships where things stay awkward for a long time after one of the two confesses and the other one tries to calmly move things back to friendship level. You can tell Imani is saddened but understanding about the situation. I would just want to push the two together regardless of the consequences in the future. I really don't see why the mc doesn't approve of a sexual relationship at least. He got Yumi to follow them into Imani's room even under the expectation of just "friend-sex" or whatever. What's wrong with that? It's not like one more body is gonna is gonna destroy the mc and if they keep it strictly professional at school, friendship outside and sex in private, I don't see how they can possibly fuck up the relationship. It just feels like the mc is scared of nothing at this point, almost like with Molly.

I had a thought about Molly just now. One of her fears is "growing up". Do you think she will be happy or feel bad in a way the moment she finds out the world is in a time loop and she never WILl grow up? I bet that she will be happy about it. Maybe there is some fear but I think knowing there is some supernatural shit going on will add to the excitement knowing she's a gamer and also a chuunibyou.

In other news. Imani is currently giving the fuck you to the nine million Niki posters. Good times.

I can't get over the size difference going on here. Knowing that Karin is taller than both Wakana and Imani is kinda strange. You expect age to match length, but that's not always the case.

6 hours!? Didn't it say Niki and Akira went only 3 hours?

Yeah no. I think the mc has another 20 years to go before he starts getting undesirable. Quick google suggests it can visually start happening at 30 while others at 50 depending on genetics and such.

Having to mass translate an entire spanish conversation is insulting to my time and does shit to immerse me. It's just inconvenient in every way.

Wtf is that imagery!? Get your fingers OUT of Miku's eyes!

Yep, it's that event. So much blood...

I thought for sure Miku was still taking the medicine and that's why she's in this condition. He clearly didn't tell Io to stop giving it. Makoto shouldn't know. It must be Io then, right? She must have noticed Miku's behavior, got scared and took the medicine away. Surely, right?
Well, this is withdrawal symptom.

Miku affection decreased? Well that's new.
AAAND she looks to be back to normal. Wth?

Turns out it was Makoto after all.

Ah here we go. The long overdue explanation of what happened to her parents.
How warped does your moral compass have to be for you to enter a house with a gun that you aren't legally allowed to carry and your first instinct when confronted by the people living there is to KILL them? Not maim, not knock them out but KILL? Guns are loud and there is a high chance that the neighbours heard it. Killing also makes a break-in crime into a murder which should in almost every country in the world have a MUCH higher priority. I'm sure that if you are somehow able to get a fucking gun, you should be able to get something else like pepper spray, a stun gun or something non lethal and just carry masks and gloves. How low do you have to fucking fall to default to kill on sight with GUNS of all things? I don't buy it. This fictional scenario is ridiculous. It's the worst of the worst kind.
Also didn't the robbers say the family has a kid? What kind of fucking idiot goes for the lethal method knowing the people who live there have a kid!? I get that you are an idiot and went and did something that ended up with you taking some lone from a lone shark and you get desperate, but if you have a fucking gun in, there must be MUCH better options to pay of that lone then breaking in and killing people.
No matter how much I look at this scenario, it just seems stupid to me and paint these criminals as the worst of the worst kinds. Stupidity combined with a broken moral compass makes me angry as fuck.

Wait... Ami and Ayane are wearing Maya's clothes, wtf? Okay that's pretty funny. Wonder if Maya is aware of this.
Yep... You should just go back to sleep. 1 Maya is enough, 3 might just kill you.
I can relate to that. I also want to see Maya mad. Imagine if these two just follow Maya around the whole party saying things Maya would say. She might actually get seriously angry and storm out.

What is Maya dressed as?
A fucking laugh track, glorious.
Yep, there it is! Her patience ran out.
Oh yeah. March 7th. Thought that costume looked familiar.

How many new words have I encountered playing this game so far? There's an alarming amount of them, and I could have sworn one of those words just mean the exact same thing as one I have already learned so it was completely pointless to use it.

They are going to "run train" on Maya all day long? Is that another way to say they are going to rail her? Sorry, sorry. Just had to make that joke. The game too.

That synchronized "You're disgusting" from Maya and Ayane got me good! It kinda works too since Ami is an Arakawa.

How did I once again predict a scare?

Let it be known that Sensei wants to put his dick in food. Amen?

Okay, yeah that's not normal decor.

Ok so, this is that moment where I must one again comment on people costumes.
Yasu dressing as Clara... Her hair is white but the personality don't quite match.
Molly dressed as Silver Wolf which is very fitting, but once again there is a personality mismatch.
Molly finished Kafka's outfit Afterall. Man, people went HARD for that character... puns... intended?
Futaba as Bronya, no idea how that matches at all.
Nodoka as a fucking nun for whatever reason...
Rin is zone tan which is so fucking random and unexpected.

Yeah, I'm fucking lost. These 10 steps got me confused.

The fact that Rin is somehow okay with sitting next to someone with absolutely zero disregard for peoples privacy or even safety is quite disgusting. It's just a matter of time before Nodoka writes about something that Rin doesn't want in the book.

Rip Karin. Cause of death: Married?

Oh, that's what the "Am I Pretty" thing meant. Apparently it was said by the character she's cosplaying as. Bet saying no means she kills you or something.

Rip ghost Karin. Cause of death: Married again?

What is Imani even suppose to be? Is she just trying to be more professional?

NSA friend sex? Non sexual assault? National security agency?
And there we go again... Calling HIM racist now.

For fuck sake Sans... Now what is this? Banana maskot?

I don't know how many would feel knowing others have her entire wardrobe of clothes. Given how she reacted to others dressing as her, I think that thought would unsettle her more than anything.

The belly doesn't seem naked unless the belly button is exposed.

What is it with Uta and melting to Chika's chin scritches?

HOLY FUCK that's Makoto! She looked so differently I couldn't tell! So much exposed skin and a different haircut in a dim room.

Of course handbags are the cause of the "no pockets on female clothes" nonsense. That's the only logical explanation.

What does it say about Yumi for knowing who Noriko was cosplaying as which the others could not?
Well her response was about as boring as could be.

Otoha is Kizuna Ai, Niki is Suizei and apparently Nao is a police officer and so is Kaori.

Oh god! Well rip mc I guess! He has chlamydia apparently!

I don't know WHY but, Kaori is cuter than Nao is in that and I don't like it. Or maybe I'm somehow confusing cuteness for intimidation? Or it's both?
Nao got cute again. All she had to do was open her... text communication?

Does Nao somehow know Kaori isn't suppose to say the name of the person Kaori kissed? But how and why?

Why do I feel bad for Otoha for being talked to this way by Niki? Otoha deserve to be criticized when everything is considered.

It's weird how Otoha is somehow able to keep it together. She looks sad, yes. But she doesn't cry or have drastic facial expression shifts, I think.

What is it with Kirin and blackmailing the richest girls in Kumon-mi?

Let me guess. She's done special makeup on her mouth and it doesn't look very kissable in true Kuchisake Onna fashion.
Called it. It's still makeup tho. I would go for it.
Akira is a coward. Let it be known.

Maybe there is someone to Noriko's words there. Maybe she DID do something horrible in another world which Maya is aware of and is not being punished by God for it.

In a way, it was good that Io went and medicated Miku. Miku got to feel both the upsides and the full force of downsides of taking medicine recklessly. Io learned what happens when you share medicine and the shock value of everything made people care for Miku more than they already did and the experienced pushed Miku in the right direction. Just kinda shitty knowing it could have killed or done irreparable damage to Miku. Lesson learned.

Me: Getting ready to call it for the night. The game: Spider jumpscares. Thanks.
Also, a long as fuck reading reading transition section. Probably nonsense but I have it recorded so... *sigh* time to read I guess.

There is also a cat like shape there, (Pet the cat) something related to Maya maybe? and the bsod under it, Wires maybe? (Maya did talk about a religion that sounded like it had something to do with wires at some point right?). No idea how to connect it to the following Nodoka events though. And they only raise more questions.

I did think Nodoka being related to Akira was expected, even sister (half-sister probably?) was possible in my mind. But regardless of the exact relation, how would he have ever had that conversation with her in the past? Their ages don't line up in a way that conversation would be possible, as far as I can tell from the context anyway. I guess it could just be some strange memory thing happening in the present though, or maybe the future...Either way I'm going to be thinking about this one for a while. Could they be stand-ins for other characters? that's going to get too confusing to think about if I go down that path.

Then the next part you get an image in the pareidolia mall style with binary in the top right. The old one sound effect plays over it... And who is in the pareidolia mall, Amy (Ami)...So is that implying an "Old One" connection there, I feel like it might be. That top right binary also translates to "z". And then we are told "Its a straight line it just doesn't look like it" maybe that's something to do with the various pareidolia mall image binary translations. Or maybe its something about time...But then that "z" would imply the image is the end of something.

I don't really want to commit to taking these lines of thinking anywhere yet. too many paths not enough signposts. Or maybe there are allot of signposts, just unintelligible ones.

hopeisdead6969 said:
Here's a question then: are Happy Events, slips? Or maybe some of them are, and some aren't? And how do the girl's experiences fit in?

Some slips involve the egg crack specifically, which we associate with slips, but do all of them? Are some Happy Events slips, and some just Sensei being mind broken and reliving past events? What even IS a Happy Event, exactly, as it exists in the lore? Is it a different plane? Or a different time? Or some combination of past experiences being relived? Or are the different experiences of Sensei in this never ending loop what create different fractals of realities, like planes?

We "know" there can be multiple different instances of characters in different planes or realities, given what we've seen. Do these timelines or planes or whatever they are exist in spite of the slips, or because of them? Perhaps each time Sensei makes a choice, he creates a new reality, like the whole multiverse infinite possibilities idea. Or maybe they all have existed simultaneously in perpetuity, and Sensei (or Sensei's) can jump between them?

Though that begs the question, can all Senseis slip? Or is ours special?

What I'm trying to say is, FUCK man, this game doesn't give up its secrets easily, and I'm a dumbass that can't figure shit out. Sorry for the lore rant; maybe somebody can answer some of those questions with text from the game, but I gotta say, its dense.
Click to expand...
Feel free the check out my old post about the slip appearances in the game.
fdsasdf_p said:
Slip
Click to expand...
After that due diligence, however, I came to the conclusion that the word 'slip' is yet to be very carefully defined, as plenty of times it's just "this word is said when things are fucky or before things become fucky", and rarely the necessity of connecting this word with some distinctive functionalities surfaces. For the sake of this argument though, the broadest understanding that I could conjure is that slips mean someone traversing through planes/dimensions/states of mind/anywhere at all and result in something freaky on screen. Therefore, all happy events count as slips but each differs in substantial ways.

The key concept that binds all examples found is You went somewhere impossible, either body or mind (or both). Therefore, for your question, I'd encourage you to consider that "a different plane", "a different time", "some combination of past experiences being relived", and "different experiences of Sensei in this never ending loop what create different fractals of realities" might be more or less the same thing altogether. If you would, you can think of them like temporarily loading a save; whether that save is an old one you yourself made, an old one someone else made, or a corrupted one is pretty much out of the control of Sensei, past iterations (I do believe that all Senseis are in the same boat as blackouts are not exclusive to the current Sensei), or other girls who are unfortunate enough to experience this as well. And you are free to define how meaningful the secret you find in save1 is to the in-game characters in save2; I just find it mostly difficult for the most part.

More importantly, I say what I said is not because this understanding is correct, but is because such a thing too matters little when it comes to begging these happy events to have any reachable meaning. But perhaps your real concern regarding all of these isn’t what slips are or what happy events are, but is something even more fundamental like “Should I regard them as real, true, or applicable to our Sensei and his current journey? If yes, in what ways? Or, are they merely acid dreams that would mean next to nothing as soon as you wake up from them?” There has never been a solid, confident answer to these if I can say so myself, and I imagine it would stay that way for a very long time.

There is a lot that could be discussed regarding the gyaru image, given that they're in Japan. There is a direct correlation in Japanese media, especially manga/anime, between the darker tone of a person's skin and their promiscuity. We must all have seen it at least in some extent (given where we are) that in corruption stories it's common for a girl to become progressively darker of skin tone as she falls into depravity.
Given that Selebus isn't Japanese though, and neither is his audience, even if he's aware of it, I don't know that he'll discuss it (because that same correlation isn't as valid to a western audience). Even when Chika addresses the idea that "gyaru girls aren't all promiscuous", it doesn't turn into a discussion and it's quite early in the game. It's barely a footnote from when she thinks Akira is assuming that she is such because of how she dresses.

Even Chika herself is of Filipino descent, thus being Selebus' own take on the gyaru genre (setting it aside from Japanese girls that develop darker skin for whatever reason), and he'd have to be insane to correlate Filipino people with promiscuity, being himself a westerner (and thus lacking of an "innocence claim" of not being aware of how offensive that would be to a culture not his own - as the Japanese might).

Imo it's more likely that he'll explore Chika's ideas of love as an individual rather than that of a gyaru, because that's a can of worms I don't think he's prepared to handle. At most, I think it's possible that if Chika goes into full depravity she'll make jokes like "Now I'm an actual gyaru", or something to the like - which, to be fair, it's not like Chika hasn't been very promiscuous in the game, it's just that she's been so towards a single person, and that it sometimes hits other people in the form of having to see her in very nsfw costumes.

In fact, I think there is a sort of dissonance inside Chika where she does see herself as sort of innocent. She even discusses it with Akira before they start dating, where Akira can say that he looks for innocence in people. Which, I mean, yes. If one is sexual only with their boyfriend, you'd hardly call them promiscuous. The big issue is that she's forcing herself to adapt to a viewpoint of love not her own (and in fact not even Akira's, as it can be seen by himself being lost as to what love even is), and that can spiral in a number of ways.
We'll have to see.

Welp. Rip Ami I guess. Somehow purged and even Maya is reacting to that. It's funny how every time something weird happens I ALWAYS look at Maya and always comment on her reaction if it's different.
Uuuuh, Ayane? What are you looking at... What is that expression?
What is going on? I'm scared! What are they looking at!?
I was joking when I said Rip Ami, wtf? That IS hers right? Or did she somehow find someone and decided to go on a murder spree?
And Sana is naked... It's not the time for this!
WTF!? Wait, but that's happening in the real world, as in the game world not fantasy land! She's been crucified!
But this is all backwards, isn't it? SHE was suppose to go on a murder spree, not be the one finding herself crucified!
ONCE AGAIN, Maya is shocked but she's not THAT shocked. Ayane is the one losing her mind and rightfully so.
Okay, that's fucked up. But in a roundabout way, I kinda see what the dev were aiming for it. If that's what he thought I mean. We've had the opportunity to start hating Ami, but now she's the victim. For a little while I've been thinking something like "If Ami died, I would be at ease" but this doesn't actually like... put me at ease. Doesn't make me feel anything else tho.
Also, is her legs stretched too? Maybe even her arms. It's hard to tell.
Is Ayane gonna lose the memory of what she has just seen? She is basically having a mental breakdown.
Oh god... Ayane getting a taste of the pure horror that the world can unleash on people. She is NOT doing okay right now.
Other than Sensei, Ami is probably the one person Ayane doesn't want to lose. So seeing that one person murdered and displayed in front of you... I dunno what kind of fuckery the world intends to do to ease this pain.
And now she's puking... fair...
And Maya's expression is back to normal for whatever reason...
And she's being a little insensitive... Not a good look for you Maya.
I don't remember what Maya said back then. She's watched people melt, disintergrate or however else she described it, but did she mentioned she saw them die like this? I don't think she did, but given her reaction, I'm not sure if she's just trying to hold it together even tho it's not fine or if something like this has happened before.
Sana is having a VERY good time! At least someone is...
Isn't Ami sitting right next to Akira?
Well. It's officially THAT time again. I wish I had another 2 hours or so.
Mmm, yum. Ami's arms for dinner? My favorite.
Can you NOT cut your dick off PLEASE? That thing is like, 80% of the reason to play.
Wait, it's all Sensei?
Wait, it's all Ami?
Rain king is just everything that's happened in the past but it's all Ami.
Who the fuck are they? Tsurumi and Kanon?
You need all kinds of skills and mindsets to play this game properly. I dread to imagine how you would brute force some of these things. Like the Pegasus thingy, how? Maybe there is a clue somewhere in the house.
Barbara is so hot frfr.
Yasu's dialogue seemed too normal. It's like this is happening in the future.
Dude, I thought that was Sara speaking... Then he mentioned mom and I got confused, so looked at the name and sure enough, that was Sana who is speaking perfectly and it more cheerful. And apparently her mother may have had cancer or something? How far in the future is this suppose to be? Like 20 years? 30? 40?
And we get to see her. She certainly looks better but I dunno why the eyes have to be blurred for this.
I wonder if this is a future where Ami is still dead.
Honestly I would say that Sana's anywhere from 20-35 here. She might be Sara's age.
Oh, okay. Eyes no longer blurred.
Hmm, if there isn't already, there may likely be a care package where you get to see that older Sana scene.
Honestly, that's kinda hot. She shows up for the moment, they go at it and then she leaves. I dunno, it just feels kinda nice but it's hard to put the emotion into writing.
What's the deal with all the guns and ammo in his house?
Better days huh... Well that's sad. It's like this event is suppose to make you sad or something.
What a majestic parrot.
Well, 2030 has past, so probably like 10 years at least.
I feel like someone not using a guide could be stuck at the reset events for hours upon hours, and that's if they remember everything the game has told them and seen everything there is to see. Even then I'm not sure you would be able to just know everything and have to guess. But that's probably on me.
I'm starting to understand what all the guns mean. I mean, it's obvious. The guide pretty much says "kill everyone" at the bottom.
Wait, is that Maki and Makoto? That's ntr territory right there.
And that's Chinami, isn't it? Yep, even confirms it.
And Uta... That's not too hard to believe. Guess she sold her soul and gave up on hiding.
I'm actually hurting just a tiny bit watching these...
There's something wrong, the door, why isn't the fucking door giving me an option to leave!?
Okay, the fucking rabbit. Had to do that 7 times. God I hate this, I hate that this game keeps ruining my sleep, especially on chapter changes.
Choosing to stay doesn't close the game this time.
You know, this is NOT how I expected Ami to kill everyone. Apparently she just had to tell an armed Akira they are enemies while his memories are gone.
I have to go through another 18 students worth of dialogue... Fml.
Thanks Maya. You saved me so much fucking reading! Hahaha!
Kirin has nothing to do with any bridge...
Man, I hate resets.
35 days... Imagine spending 35 days in a broken world alone with nothing but the sleeping body of the person you love...
It is impossible for 2 people to repopulate the planet. These genes will cause a chain reaction of more and more damaged genes in their children. Even if they survive a few generations, it won't last long. It's a childish fantasy and impossible as far as I've heard.
I'm gonna make a guess and say Maya is not in her room and neither are the others... but... what about floor 3 and up? Also, what about the Maya box room? What about her actual boxes in her room? Surely this time one of them will have something?
Well, there is no one in the dorms, as expected. Still only the first two floors.
...seriously? No, seriously... wtf? Why?
Welp... older Sana is back.
Wait, Maya!? I'm guessing this was the last option she could think of? And that should definitely mean the thing preventing them from getting close should be gone.
No?
The dev wouldn't do that, right? No, that would be equivalent to forcing a genuine feeling of loss and grief on the player which the Ami situation didn't do.
I can't believe that whole Ayane situation blindsided me and then I got thrown into this instead. That's not better, that's worse! That feels more real!
And the fucking flashbacks!
I'm starting to feel like this is all some giant prank of hers.
...?
Is the thing he was suppose to lose Maya?
Makoto is here... just as I hoped... I had a feeling that might happen... but it's so greatly overshadowed by the loss of Maya... Of course I'm not ready to accept that loss, and I probably never will...
I still keep thinking about those blasted boxes...
And Ami is back. Again, who the fuck cares!?
The fucking game is mocking us now. Putting Makoto where Maya sat...
Even the sign is mocking us.
Ami is doing her best to remind him that not EVERYTHING is lost just because Maya supposedly is. Maya is yet to say ANYTHING implying that she knows about the reset things. Yet somehow it's like both Ayane and Makoto knows. Which also implies that Maya may actually be reset, which really doesn't make sense considering how she probably has millions of years worth of mostly forgotten memories and experiences which are worth far too much to just lose.
If I tried to go to sleep right now, I wouldn't be able to. Or I don't want to. I just can't calm down, can't stop thinking.
Maya interrupted Makoto talking about the rooftop apocalypse stuff. Maya is also being Maya, no different from the millions of years version of her. Shouldn't she be different?
I hate this! This is not Maya! The game is fucking ruined!
There has to be some future event that gives her memories back, or it might happen in the next few events, I don't know, but this is not Maya.
His been gone for almost 2 months...
I legit feel like lying in a dark corner in fetal position or something. Sure, I get upset when characters are killed off, but knowing how much I've grown attached to these characters, and the fact I put extreme value on memories, this feels so horrible. It's because it's a game and I'm still holding out hope knowing there are many more chapters and many more events that may return the original Maya.
Either the mc's absence will help Chika move on from him or it will make things even worse.

posts.content_html_raw:
So already played through once, let it stew and now gonna replay and share my thoughts as I go ala Void. Reading through everyone's comments I have to agree with a lot and since a lot of what I would say has already been said I'll just stick to what catches my fancy.

Did not realize that it was the 56th floor of the dorm (That has two floors as far as I am aware) that had a pipe burst. I like that we are starting in the bathhouse for various reasons, one being getting to see Io early in her grumpiness. How much money is in unpoppable bubble wrap cause damn lol. Nice to see Ayane but very nice to see Rin and her new financial stability and confidence too add to it, looks like Rika's job is very minimal. I don't get the smooth jazz reference, something I forgot probably.

Yay for Molly and Tsuneyo also Nu Maya and Ami are still acting way to normal. Did not expect Nu Maya to woof. Oh yeah Ayane is big on being a mother so it would make sense she would have books. Tsuneyo's confidence is to be envied at times lol. I am enjoying Rin and Futaba's little talk but it is weird how accepting Futaba is of Akria sleeping with other girls. Hehe Tsuneyo appears as Molly faints and leads to a cute scene lol.

Oh guess that makes more sense as to why Rin wasn't too upset about Akria having her picture, I figured that was the case but it's nice to have confirmation. Oh didn't catch this on my first play through, it's the fact that he's her teacher that first started the feelings, interesting. Oh never mind, though it's neat to learn that even before Otaha she was in love with Akira like that. I knew it was coming and I still get a bit anxious when the scene cuts to Rika lol. Also side note Osako's hair plus her nice abs *Homer Simpson drool* I agree with others how did he forget his phone like that, unlocked to. Is this the doing of the gods I wonder. Hehe Rika looking to join Akria and Imani and oh music fade away. That pause did not help, Rika being a mom is actually nice to see. Rin's text are a bit creative ngl, circling back to Rika being a mom it actually makes me like her character more, her reaction is normal and shows that yes while she isn't the smartest or best parent, she's still Rin's mom and wants to make sure she is protected. Why 5 minutes? baffling now that I think about it. Silver-back Gorillas, is this gonna be a Rin thing now lol

Enter Chika and oh callback to the wishing well neat, hopefully if she does decide to get in the bucket it's someone pulling it up, not something. Oh crying and scared Rin, I am not prepared. Oh that shot of them holding hands and sitting side by side is actually really nice. Hm knowing what I know will happen in the end of the update the No one takes away the horny statement seems to hit a bit different. Oh again knowing what I know and having read other's take yeah, it looks like Chika's sense of love has really become warped, using sex as a way to comfort and share her love with Rin, more on this when I get to her actual TSS event. Huh, after seeing that screen shot of Sel talking about how Chika went differently then he had originally wanted makes me feel like the following scene after Chika goes down on Rin is less the gods and more Sel actually self inserting lol

The Sana invite event, getting her number from the pic the second option has dialogue that really showed how different Sana is compared to the beginning of the game. Hm why swarm him and use his body for their own use instead of being embarrassed at being seen with a hard on, another small bit of dialogue that makes me wonder. It's good that he's conscious and worried after what happened with Miku, also he has a whole other place why keep using the one Niki is at if he wants to actually hide, or is he subconsciously trying to get caught so he can be punished and hated by her, food for thought. Return of cute cyclops Sana hazzah. Sana brings up good points, I think Niki is just waiting for Akira to actually confess. Hm the comments about Ami Niki is making, making me think and ponder. Sana's acting is pretty good and that switch flip after Niki goes to shower, damn lol. Sex scene is pretty meh and Akira feeling awkward about it in the beginning subtracts from it even more. Oh Sana looks cute with heart eyes. The flash forward and Akira getting mixed feelings from and remembering/not remembering Times New Roman and realizing that the Sana from there and the Sana here are very different, his revelation of realizing he's being used, wonder if he will link it to how he was in the beginning. Sana being the first to have a normal response to being cum into makes sense, also took almost four chapters and how many hours for someone to point it out as bad bad lol. Oh yeah that death comment, not cool.

And now on to my fav Irish weeb, Molly \(^_^)/ invite event. I like Akira is just blatantly caring to her and shows her aggressive affection, feels right. Sparkle eyes Molly, too cute <3. Ah the we live in Japan but are pretty American comment, classic. Despite my misgivings about Ami, that is an adorable pose and outfit. Oh this is when he started looking for a hobby and is it cause
Pareidolia is now gone that he's seeking something to occupy the quiet. The halflings jab was hilarious and clever lol. Woot Molly learns about Akira's Otaku days, reaction is spot on. Oh damn I didn't realize the green shirt wasn't attached to the white and is just a shoulder over coat thing, that actually looks really good, Sel can really make designs looks fantastic, also cute Chunni pose.

Molly invite event part 2 the reckoning. She's weird but she's also Molly sums up how I feel about that adorable Emerald Otaku. Molly just understands, all about that build up (Though too much build up can be a bad thing sometimes) also Molly understands, sometimes letting go of something that made you happy just because society says you have to in order to fit in can be sad and suck. Love this invite event, adore Molly, and these scenes hit all the right buttons. Still even the second time my fav invite so far, the hottest and good cleanser for Sana's.

First off, why gross sound continue, second call sign in the code? Five more years? Another small line that feels important, maybe. Haruka event and I am now noticing that it feels like Sel really upped the adorable factor for the poses and clothing cause Haruka, if I was in Akira's place damn my hands would not be idle. While I'm glad the whole Cafe thing didn't go longer and get more complicated then it did, I am curious how Sel would of handled it. Hm, did we ever get any hints how into Sana Haruka is, I think we did but I may be misremembering. NGL I like bratty Haruka for some reason.

The train thing is werid and I expect nothing less from Sel. No I did not notice and still don't really hear a beating heart in the bass. Rin going to Haruka for advise feels like a bad idea and is probably gonna be a bad idea but like that weird train thing it is hard to not wanna watch and see where it goes.

Right forgot the spider jump scare was here, fucking Sel. Ah the Tsuneyo, Kaori and Nao-chan scene. Her talking to the tomato was fun. Ah the thing with Sekai awakened something in her. I still adore Kaori and am looking forward of more scenes with her. Ok, wow now that someone else had mentioned it and I'm taking a closer look Nao-chan really is a mix of different girls, Ami and Maya's eye colour, Yumi's hair, Tsuneyo's skin colour, Chinami's wizardness. Nao-chan's smug face is glorious lol. Oh Sekai is whispering to Kaori, not good, maybe good, we'll have to see. Always get creeped out seeing those pencil creatures, but seeing that and Tsuneyo calling it dad made it click in my head that every pencil creature is probably connected to Wires. Also I wasn't sure who he was telling to get out until I saw Kaori's line, is he trying to protect Tsuneyo or is this version of Sekai a threat to him/Wires, why did he want her out enough to make an appearance, who's Peter and is the God the text referring to Wires or another. More stuff to look forward to learning

Chika and Rin in the bath, Rin is cutely blushing and Chika is just giving her a smile. Adorable factor feels like it has risen indeed. Was Rin's hair always that long and I'm now noticing cause it feels longer then I remember it being a few updates ago. Also that talk between them, that's good writing, despite tits on the screen my whole focus was on the dialogue, tits also kind of being at the same level did help a bit ngl. Chinami is always adorable and her socks, cute. Also GoT reference. Rin can't help herself from cursing is fun to watch. spoilers.title: Chika TTS
spoilers.html: Going into the Chika maid event and dear lord it's already been 3 hours and 45 minutes. The maid cafe scenes are always fun to watch and read, nice little breath of amusement since I know what's coming up. The conversation between Chika and Akira is really good, definitely moves Chika up in rankings and makes me like her more like I use to, I know Sel said it wasn't his intention for this to happen and that it just wrote it self as Chika wanted it to but I'm glad it went that way, even if I do agree that it kind of feels like her TSS was a punishment for this. Hm narration mentions that if Chinami and Akira start having sex it means that she has hit rock bottom, theory what if her TSS was to prepare and make her more accepting of Akira praying on Chinami and the end with her older self was a glimpse of her future where she spiraled after losing Chinami, dressed a mannequin in her clothes and pretend that she's around to keep her happy and stable just like she's doing with Akira now. Also faceless Chinami, *shutter* Also forgot AmIOkay was there, mischivious look naked. Also been realizing a lot of scenes having posters with flowers in the background, relevant not sure but keeping it in mind. I do miss Blonde Chika ngl. The conversation between Chika and the monster feels more like her confronting herself, fighting against herself that she can no longer recognize. Chinami dog head is here and oh I did not see the hanging feet in the background last time. I can see this event going different ways, leading to her becoming more open for Akira to prey on Chinami and Tsukasa, or warp her view on love so bad she starts trying to be more intimate with Rin and starts to do that with Yumi as well, thinking that sex is the only way to show real love. Also I don't think she actually went through a 19 year long orgy, I think this space represents her new changed state of mind vs her original going by her reaction and the fact she looks like her old self, I think the addition of Chinami may be either a way for the gods to interfere in some way to make her fall or her new self trying to convince the last piece of her old self to truly fall into madness, or I could be completely wrong and missing everything. As for the end, I think it's just a flashforward of a possibility, a Chika who has lost everything and is using a mannequin to replace the sister she lost.

spoilers.title: Nodoka
spoilers.html: Forgot this invite event starts with a Happy Event screen, Akira wanting to wear a mask so the rest of him can be ignored and mentions of wrestling which may not be wrestling and more allusions that his brother may of hurt him first, but it being just physical or sexual remains to be seen. weird lighting screen with Akira and Nodoka being related which everyone else as theorized out the wazo so won't dive much on this...Ok scratch that why does it feel like childhood friends and not siblings talking to one another, also mentions of the well, Rain King. I feel like he's referring to Nodoka less as a bio sister and more close as a sister friend. They know eachother cause they have to wait for the well to dry before leaving, close their eyes when they do leave after the well dries, more allusions of Akira and Nodoka being gods themselves maybe. Oh annoying sound but series of binary in the top corner during the black and white scene. Angry monster O_O loud. Himawari mentioned, flower in her hair, market research? Mentions of Nodoka being killed by Ami, so he does have memory of that. Oh cat mentioned, lots of cat references and depictions in this game. More foreshadowing/red herring of Nodoka not being real (test Tube) and combining her name with Ami to make her feel like a god, chances something was left or she's figured something out. Oh did not catch the dream dialouge the first time, interesting. Is Nodoka in the dream his daughter, sister, and the dark cloud Ami or something else, more questions to look forward to the answers for. Rabit in the foreground, another thing shown and referenced a lot. I had noticed but now actually looking can confirm for myself they do have the same or very very close eye colour. Nodoka calling her Ami Prime after seeing it here for the past while is surreal lol. Once more Akira's line of thinking and logic strikes again.  Other people have way better things to say about the rest of the event so I'll just add, I'm curious what Nodoka's end goal is, and where it will go from here.

Seconded on Goddess's Whim! Fun, silly game -- but the animations are great, at least when it comes to KK.

A thing to remember about KK animations -- Koikatsu is, what, a decade old? There continue to be new mods made to make it more sophisticated, but animating in CharaStudio is still a pain in the ass. The controls aren't intuitive or particularly well documented. Doing anything that hasn't already been scripted by someone else takes a huge amount of time and isn't easy to get right (he says, as someone who's tried and failed). It's tough to get the bodies and all their component parts to play along with each other in sync without heading into body horror or Uncanny Valley territory.

Sel can do all kinds of fun things by exporting images created in CharaStudio and playing with them in Photoshop. But getting as fancy with Premiere or another video editor isn't anywhere nearly as easy, and in any case the original video has to be good, or the edited version will be crap. GIGO.

Here's some belated 0.47 observations and speculation, mostly lore-related, with a few thoughts on characters/plot along the way.
I guess the fact that it took me this long to this post is an indication that I wasn't as excited to talk about stuff as I have been with the last few updates. I did really enjoy it, though, mostly as self-contained entertaining scenes - this wasn't like 0.43 which felt like all setup with no payoff. It was a nice change of pace from the lore dumps we've been getting lately.

The highlights for me are the serious conversations where Rin and Chika (both separately and together) are trying to figure out who they want to be as people, and the hilarious Ami & Nodoka interaction. Also good to see Rika have the start of an actual plot arc, I really hope it goes somewhere.
The termite queen (Sekai?) has tasked someone with chewing through a deathbed (I presume Mr. Tojo). Also references the replica of heaven, which in "Good Boy" has all the staircases blocked with mounds of dirt.
Mr. Tojo is still alive according to Tsuneyo, and she recognizes his voice when Wires speaks.

Wires wants to get some sort of "infection" out - I think out of him, given the way things are breaking down, but possibly out of Kaori. This might also relate to the "LET ME OUT" message which has recurred in relation to Sekai. His text has been crossed out, which is a favorite trick of Pareidolia aka the Hyphen-Knight.
Speaking of hyphens, in "SENSEI-QUEST" Long Maya says that Sensei is doomed now that he doesn't have the assistance of the hyphenated one. "Four Letter Words":

My second thought is "tuberculosis isolation". I could have sworn Io lived outside of Kumon-mi until she moved in with her aunt. Am I misremembering, or is the doctor's office scene evidence that Yasu also used to live somewhere else?

I don't know what Perfect Face Boy is supposed to be, but the last one was bought by (presumably) Himawari as "market research", meaning it's probably produced by a competitor to HimawariCo such as the Shiawase Group.

Maybe she's a bit more affectionate toward Sensei, but she still treats him more like a research subject than a partner.

We have decent reason to believe that the white rabbits belong to Pareidolia (if you're unfamiliar, search for old posts on the subject). Three rabbits on the bed for three Arakawas on the bed, representing three cases of hereditary Pareidolia "infection"?
Other people have done a good job discussing the larger implications of the scene, so for now I just want to point out some supporting observations.

Chika's rabies is apparently caused by her own "worm of Giles Corey". When this has been previously used (for Sensei and Ami) it seemed like it was describing the supernatural parasites that are affecting their thoughts. Has a supernatural entity also been fucking with Chika? I wouldn't have thought so, but now I'm not sure.

I'm sure it comes as no surprise that none of this scene takes place in the real Kumon-mi, but we can be 100% certain of that fact because the Kumon-mi wall is missing.

Chinami generic:

Unobstructed view from Sensei's apartment:

The mall is now the "Great [REDACTED] Mall". I don't think there's any reason for Pareidolia's name to be redacted - whether he's actually gone or not, Sensei has had no problem thinking of him by name since he left. I'm guessing the mall is now under "new ownership", probably the New Hope we saw in the reset.

As Chika agrees to be used, she's turned into a puppet hanging under a sky with three moons, I assume indicating she's being controlled by the three gods. But I'm unclear whether she gave in by choice (to protect Chinami) and that made her a puppet, or if she was forced to give in unwillingly.
I'm confused as to how this TSS fits in with the others. spoilers.title: Perfect Face Boy
spoilers.html:
The event starts with someone other than Sensei speaking in all lowercase who remembers a "really fun day" from Akira's youth where he got rug burn from what's implied to be something sexual. This has to be Pareidolia talking, right? The "best friend" inside young Akira's head, who would have also experienced the "really fun" rape from the perspective of Sekai/Nozomu.

The characters aren't allowed to go home (leave Terminal 23) until the well runs dry. It sounds like the only reason Sensei and Nodoka know each other (i.e. the only reason Terminal 23 exists) is because someone else broke this rule - maybe Yuu left Terminal 22 early, hence why no one remembers him? Alternatively, it could be Kyoko or the Akira who killed himself in Terminal 22.
We seemingly got confirmation that Nodoka is Sensei's half-sister through Yuu (since they have different moms in the dream), though there's enough in the dream that's clearly not real that we should still retain some doubt - for example, dream Sensei clearly isn't an adult, so the age gap is much smaller.

I don't know what Perfect Face Boy is supposed to be, but the last one was bought by (presumably) Himawari as "market research", meaning it's probably produced by a competitor to HimawariCo such as the Shiawase Group.

It's been pointed out that Ms. Matsubara was the other class's teacher before she was retconned to Wakana as a member of the game's cast. Maybe the name reference here is just a fourth wall-breaking in-joke, but I wonder if this is indicating an in-universe change in the timeline. As in, Ms. Matsubara was originally a fake person as part of the simulation, until she was replaced by the real person Wakana when she was sucked into Terminal 23.

spoilers.title: Chika's TSS
spoilers.html:
Other people have done a good job discussing the larger implications of the scene, so for now I just want to point out some supporting observations.

Chika's rabies is apparently caused by her own "worm of Giles Corey". When this has been previously used (for Sensei and Ami) it seemed like it was describing the supernatural parasites that are affecting their thoughts. Has a supernatural entity also been fucking with Chika? I wouldn't have thought so, but now I'm not sure.

I'm sure it comes as no surprise that none of this scene takes place in the real Kumon-mi, but we can be 100% certain of that fact because the Kumon-mi wall is missing.

Chinami generic:

Unobstructed view from Sensei's apartment:
The scene begins and ends with the shadows of transmission towers prominently cast on the apartment door. I doubt this could happen by coincidence with Koikatsu lighting, maybe it's showing how "wires" are what transported Chika to and from this place.
The mall is now the "Great [REDACTED] Mall". I don't think there's any reason for Pareidolia's name to be redacted - whether he's actually gone or not, Sensei has had no problem thinking of him by name since he left. I'm guessing the mall is now under "new ownership", probably the New Hope we saw in the reset.

After there was one hanging set of feet in Makoto's TSS, there are four this time. I'm still not sure on the significance, though I am reminded of the hanging Mayas in "Second Sun".
As Chika agrees to be used, she's turned into a puppet hanging under a sky with three moons, I assume indicating she's being controlled by the three gods. But I'm unclear whether she gave in by choice (to protect Chinami) and that made her a puppet, or if she was forced to give in unwillingly.
I'm confused as to how this TSS fits in with the others. The rest all seemed to be the result of wishes by the girls, but this time it seems like the supernatural side initiated things in order to "correct" Chika so that she will accept the harem without going insane. I guess maybe Chika could have wished to protect Chinami (she does think about it on the way home from the maid cafe), but the TSS only has a fake Chinami and Chika doesn't actually protect her.

1) Sel revealed a few years ago that he lives (or at least lived) in Houston, TX. I don't know if this is still true, but my breakdown assumes it is.
2) Sel is self-employed, which puts some stressors on finances that most of us may not think of.

Taxes: American's pre-pay most of our federal taxes. A percentage is withheld from our paychecks, and at the start of every year we do the math and submit paperwork to show that we either did not pay enough, or paid too much and are due a refund. Since Sel is self-employed, this pre-payment does not automatically happen, and he has to save up to pay (he can pre-pay on his own if he desires, but it's not required, though I would encourage it if you're making that kind of money). This is for the federal income tax, only.

In addition, there are seperate "payroll taxes" for Social Security and Medicare that are paid directly through payroll deduction. As a payroll tax, this is paid 50/50 by both the employer and the employee. When we're self-employed, that means we pay both halves -- meaning the tax burden is a little bit higher for him than it is for me (a corporate stooge).

The third thing is health insurance. Most Americans receive a health insurance policy through their employer (or their partner's employer). If self-employed, or if the employer doesn't offer that benefit, you can get a policy on the individual market. The individual market is VERY expensive, and getting moreso every year. There are subsidies that help reduce that cost, but at the kind of money he brings in, he likely does not qualify for them. I don't know if he gets his coverage through his wife's employer or the individual market, so this may or may not be a major expense for him. But if he and his wife are both getting coverage through the individual market, that expense is probably larger than their mortgage payment.

In terms of cost of living, Houston is fairly inexpensive, especially for a city of its size. Of the 20 largest cities in Texas, it's the 10th most expensive (Texas is, on the whole, in the middle of the pack -- substantially cheaper than the states non-Americans typically think of, like California or New York). The most expensive thing specific to Texas is property taxes, since Texas doesn't have a state income tax, most of the state's revenue comes from a point-of-sale sales tax and property taxes, and the general consensus in the state is that property taxes in particular are growing out of control.

$10k/month comes out to $120k/year. To put this into perspective, the median HOUSEHOLD income in the US for 2023 was $80k. The median personal income for that year was $42k. A salary of $167K would put you in the top %10 of earners. Sel's income from Subscribestar alone puts him in the upper middle class, and that's not factoring in any income from his wife.

So he's doing pretty well for himself. He could afford to hire someone to help him, but that's a sucker's bet. Set as much as possible aside for legal expenses in this political climate. Oklahoma is already trying to ban all forms of pornography in that state, and it's likely Texas will try to follow suit.

1) Sel revealed a few years ago that he lives (or at least lived) in Houston, TX. I don't know if this is still true, but my breakdown assumes it is.
2) Sel is self-employed, which puts some stressors on finances that most of us may not think of.

Taxes: American's pre-pay most of our federal taxes. A percentage is withheld from our paychecks, and at the start of every year we do the math and submit paperwork to show that we either did not pay enough, or paid too much and are due a refund. Since Sel is self-employed, this pre-payment does not automatically happen, and he has to save up to pay (he can pre-pay on his own if he desires, but it's not required, though I would encourage it if you're making that kind of money). This is for the federal income tax, only.

In addition, there are seperate "payroll taxes" for Social Security and Medicare that are paid directly through payroll deduction. As a payroll tax, this is paid 50/50 by both the employer and the employee. When we're self-employed, that means we pay both halves -- meaning the tax burden is a little bit higher for him than it is for me (a corporate stooge).

The third thing is health insurance. Most Americans receive a health insurance policy through their employer (or their partner's employer). If self-employed, or if the employer doesn't offer that benefit, you can get a policy on the individual market. The individual market is VERY expensive, and getting moreso every year. There are subsidies that help reduce that cost, but at the kind of money he brings in, he likely does not qualify for them. I don't know if he gets his coverage through his wife's employer or the individual market, so this may or may not be a major expense for him. But if he and his wife are both getting coverage through the individual market, that expense is probably larger than their mortgage payment.

In terms of cost of living, Houston is fairly inexpensive, especially for a city of its size. The two first titles I have no idea, but I'd add that the dragon fits both the Yakuza theme and Yumi's fighting posters on her bedroom.

Ittekimasu is something that is very common in Japanese culture, that we'd be seeing between Ami and Akira all the time, and that we don't because the game is in English.

Rin wearing the same jacket shirt thingy as Imani but it's teal instead of blue.

fdsasdf_p said:
Want to weigh in on this a little more as I feel like this is a much more impactful factor than which state or which country Selly is in.

He’s riding high for the most part, but ultimately those numbers come from patronage. It’s not salaried or paid by the hour; it highly fluctuates and is easily susceptible to a shit ton of things (platform shenanigans for one). You’re not guaranteed to be on this 10k streak for however long, and most importantly it definitely won’t last forever. Constantly banking on the unwavering generosity of your supporters to pay your rent sounds fucking horrifying, especially once LiL is finished. Literally nothing is sustainable even just by short to midterm range.

Thus I won’t fault the guy for trying to get a little more when he still can. Everything he has is quite temporary and not easily transferrable to other career paths with equal pays; it’s always the method he chooses that earns the eyerolls.
Click to expand...
Yeah, it’s the manner of some of his interactions I always wonder about. Lousy marketing.

One of the more brilliant things he did, tbh, was to go full epic. Most projects like this either last a few years, or trickle out. Having a decade-long serial-release piece? If you can make it work over the long haul, it’s quite a business plan.

VoidExile

VoidExile said:
It's weird that Kaori is able to be called. Why?
Rika too apparently... I'm so confused by the choices. Is this just how he is now? He just wants to meet people without a proper explanation?
Click to expand...
It's a little inconsistent with Ayane but I think she gets a pass since she's the only one who actually gets it. Otherwise it's the people who don't make him feel like shit with their love for him.

And Nao makes shit weird. That evening call with the mall music also gives a Nao point.

VoidExile said:
Autovn made him skip to evening when Touka's dialogue hadn't even been read. Having to do things manually is stupid.
There is no one to hang out with but Ayane and Nodoka at this time in pool and Library. This is incredibly restrictive...

A lot of events were just added... Almost thought that was impossible and this was just going to be slow as hell. I mean, it is, sort of.

It's a Monday and he now has access to the computer. I guess that's what the "greater facade" thing is. He's just gotten so bad that he has to fake everything to stay somewhat sane.
Click to expand...
And there were several months of reaching the end of events that mostly played themselves after walking around in circles for a week where you'd end up with these choices. It was kinda miserable.
In fact, the computer wasn't even available for most of this time. The only reason it came back was because he started making Bonus Animations and he couldn't restrict them to a sad sensei, there was never an organic moment of getting better enough compared to like dorm access or something.

VoidExile said:
Umm, so did the game just skip over all the remaining side characters first sight of him after that 2 month+ coma?
Click to expand...
Kinda. Everyone who hasn't seen him is in contact with someone who would have after the first week back. Word about his return spread faster than Masahiro's death.

VoidExile said:
She's a paradox of a person... Unpredictable yet intimidatingly smart to the core.
Click to expand...
When you reach current updates, maybe look around at some of the theories which show how right you are.

VoidExile said:
Wonder why Tsukasa calls her sister "nee-sama" when that means big brother while "nee-chan" means big sister. It is something to do with power? Choosing a more masculine nickname because men are stereotypically more powerful?
Click to expand...
You might have gotten things a little confused. Older brother is nii (like knee), older sister is nee (like the ne in near). Adding the o before them makes it more formal / respectful. And the sama is normally a more respectful / formal honorific than chan.
Mix/matching them is just because humans are stupid and once thing get comfortable they like changing them or some actual rich person dynamic that we don't understand as foreign peasants. Maybe Onee-chan is less formal than nee-sama.

VoidExile said:
He's giving Tsukasa the young Noriko treatment... And if it goes the way it did for Noriko, she will fall for him to. The green path is weird.
Click to expand...
Yeah, green path kinda veers off from "lets not shit the bed in this social situation I don't know about" into "I want to get shit done" around here.

VoidExile said:
Maya on the top of the tierlist when she too have been replaced while Ami is at the bottom of the list while she underwent the same fate? Ami's current attitude got the place she has, Maya's previous form got her the spot she has. I want Maya back, so I suppose I keep her there, expecting her to one day return. I don't want Ami back because she's been bad from the start only that I was less wise and un-immersed in the story back then.
Click to expand...
Give yourself some credit. Last time you saw Maya other than her basically 10 second cameos was at the peak of the tier list. Give her a chance to prove she needs to be moved the next time you get proper events from her, and then keep doing that.

Or make a tierlist shrine to Maya Prime, it's your grief.

VoidExile said:
Sometime I wonder if you are meant to be on a red path to reach the best ending. We won't know that in maybe 6 years. Some of the choices and events going on are certainly more concerning than others.
Click to expand...
It's weird. I'd say most choices seem kinda obvious that green path is superior because the red path options end up replacing entire scenes with throwaway sentences. Most of Sara's sex scenes get replaced with "But you don't want to have sex with me "

Not fingering / fucking Ami has a weird amount of effort put into those scenes. Sometimes it's honestly peak humor, sometimes it's compelling.

VoidExile said:
Tsukasa was the first one to max out on available events for 0.45. Honestly, the things she said... It's dark. It's like he's already won her over simply by giving her attention.
Click to expand...
You should try to find both the 0.46 and then the 0.47 patches now, and then at your pace assuming you skip the grind of the next reset events you'll probably be ready to play 0.48 on the day of it dropping.

Tsukasa gets more scenes in 0.46, and 0.47 has the bug fixes for how glitchy 0.46 ended up being. You might run into issues if you don't do it sooner rather than later.

Timeline wise, Tsukasa got the failsafe scenes in 0.38.
