posts.content_html_raw:
Day 62 character count 15681.
It's weird that some of the rooftop apocalypse gang don't acknowledge the fact it's apparently spring when that is something that's never happened before.

God damnit Tsuneyo! Stop saying misleading things to Yumi or she might actually believe it!
They are just gonna brush off the fact Tsuneyo just says her teachers "fucks" her too?

I don't remember what the 28'th december is suppose to mean.

Yumi job application time?
Yumi job application time.
Easiest interview ever?

Yumi and Noriko are like opposites, yet their style belongs in a similar category.

The muffin zone? The muffin zone!

I feel like this isn't the first time I heard this thing about Yumi maybe being self conscious about her breast size. Is she? It might make sense on account of her tomboyish sort of behavior. Well I think they are lovely. Haruka's tho? No thanks.

Yumi cleaning a table? This looks wrong!

I'm guessing an annoying customer is gonna show up and ruin Yumi's day. (I was wrong)
Uhh, untitled children's show...
Ahh, backstory... She looked so different. I thought that was Sana for a moment there. Maybe Yumi went through a cyclops phase too?
Thought the show was gonna be that cursed long Maya again.
I see what the problem is here... This show taught her about good and bad and her mother is giving into those temptations so Yumi is gonna be bitter about it.
Yup, now she's sad... Nostalgia hits hard.
Yep...
Noriko handled that situation surprisingly well. I didn't expect that at all. Thought for sure she was gonna piss Yumi off even more or even get it, but she managed to dodge making Yumi look weaker while also supporting her issue. It's the perfect approach. I guess they can be friends after all but Yumi still finds Noriko annoying. But I thought Io and Yumi could be friends too and that clearly didn't happen.

Well this is familiar... "This town has two halves", same song, same background(Oh yeah, the scene is identical). But the last time this happened... There was a kiss, arguably one of the most memorable events that set the stage for the game.

Why is THIS version of Ami here? Doesn't she only appear during happy events or resets?
OMG, I shit you not he said the exact same thing right after!
"-you were supposed to rape somebody" guess that really is what he was meant to do.
"we want to have fucking with on each other in the body. But none of the fucking happened =(" I am so sad by this news...
Staaaaaahp! Fuckin glitches!

Don't ever say something like that. "Thank you for letting me in, Yumi. I get thta this must be scary for you." Well the fact that he says that makes it even scaier.
I guess if someone deserves some honesty and answers, it's Yumi. She may complain about not knowing him enough and have problems trusting people. So entrusting a secret could help her feel more comfortable.
Just wish I didn't feel so uneasy every time he talks about Maya like she's dead... I guess this is my denial talking. There was the sadness, the anger, the denial and the acceptance, not in that order. But they are all there. So... I guess what I felt was actually a minor form of grief? How many times have I experienced this playing games? Clearly not a lot of times if I can have this conversation. Feel like I'm still a mix of all 4 emotions tho and it's about the same amount.

Seeing Yumi genuinely concerned about him is a different change of pace. This version of him is so much more genuine and less threatening.

Did that one slip through? Uh oh...
Wait, she's barely even reacting to that. No this doesn't seem right at all... Why did she barely react!? He just said he couldn't wait to fuck her in a vulgar way and she barely reacted besides from the initial shock.
So both Tsuneyo and Kaori are losing it...

If there is anything I know about scenes that are way too cute and cheerful, it's that something terrible could happen at any moment. Surprisingly there's not a lot of those.
Niceness like that is suspicious, isn't it?
Wait... that was it? It was all just a happy story followed by Kirin being Kirin again? I expected someone to die or something! Bullies show up at school to make her life difficult, that old lady getting a heart attack or getting hit by a car, Karin getting hit by a car, one of her parents dying, fucking anything! But nothing happened...

Miku: "-shoot me down" how is she able to say stuff like that anyway? Shouldn't that also trigger a reaction?

I admire Miku's openness to sex talk. It's like she doesn't understand that you are suppose to all shy talking about stuff like that. He made a threesome joke which she caught and just seemed excited to understand the joke and pointless out public law thing instead of pointing out it's wrong or something.

Wtf? Old man masturbating in public...

Three bowls of cereal? That's a bit too much... One is more than enough.

Damnit Uta, just fuck him already if you are gonna be dreaming about him!

Ahh yes. How to responsibly introduce Miku to the sex shop. "They keep the hardcore stuff in the back. That's the place you want to be."

HAHAHAHAHA! WTF!? Otoha showed up in the middle of that sex and it put me in a laughing fit!
What do you think she's thinking? That this is the best thing she's ever seen? Or does she feel bad about it?
Well I guess this is what "they came together" means.
"Something wonderful", huh. Yeah, I imagine so.

He probably doesn't raise his voice often at Niki. That's how you know his serious I guess.

Why is it not okay for Ami to let anyone see him but it is okay for others to see her? Why is it okay to not tell him about changed plans when he's the one who has been taking care of Ami? Why is it okay for Ami to be selfish but not him? Is the difference here that Ami is often concious during her state while he was not and he could have asked her about Niki and others? I don't know who to put the blame on here. Niki for not listening to him, him for not asking Ami about Niki or Ami for not telling him about changed plans, or all or two of them.
This entire situation just feels hypocritical. He didn't receive help but she did. It's like the world just wants to punish him by first suppressing his aid and then doing the right thing against his wishes by helping Ami.
Giving Niki more things to powertrip over. You didn't fucking save Ami, Ami wanted to be saved by you and not her uncle. There is a fucking difference you conceited brat!

DAMNIT SEKAI! What's with that cursed expression?

As far as the Niki moving in thing. Niki doesn't know about the kind of incestuous relationship him and Ami has, so it may not work out. But from a family standpoint, that would be the ideal choice over him wandering around aimlessly taking advantage of others, something that would be slightly harder to do with Niki there permanently.

Tsuneyo is selfaware of the shadowy figures. Honestly, I have a hunch. One of the next 1 or 3 characters making it onto the rooftop might be her at this rate. Makoto of course only took one reset I think, but she seemed next in line regardless. Hmm, but what about Sana? She's kinda involved in the supernatural stuff and is friend's with Ayane. If she's not, then I seriously question what her god has been saying to her. I wonder if Yumi was just in on it to not single out Tsuneyo during those events? Nodoka would have a field day writing about her experience. But I dread to imagine what else she would do knowing the timeline is infinite... She could very easily abuse that. Tsuneyo is about to throw the Takoyaki on the floor followed by the screams of that very same Takoyaki man who remembers her.
CALLED IT!

Oh yeah, it finally clicked for both of us. The husband thing. I faintly remember that being the theme of this theme park.

I feel like this isn't the first time that remember certain things have made a character's head hurt.

hey.
i think we should stop coming here
"

Intentional nipple hiding there from Ayane.

spoilers.html:
Я бы не сказал, что мне нравились подобные девушки, когда я учился в школе, да и будь Юми моей одноклассницей, я бы не особо интересовался ею. Даже скорее всего мы бы конфликтовали, что переросло бы во взаимную ненависть из-за наших общих проблем с контролем гнева. Стоп... Боже, я вспомнил, что у меня была собственная Юми в школе! В общем, была одна девушка из параллельного класса, с которой я постоянно срался. Но уже ближе к концу выпуска из школы я научился более или менее контролировать свой гнев, и я помирился с этой девушкой, что потом переросло в, не поверишь, влюблённость с её стороны... Она даже мне подарок личный сделала на 23 февраля. Но к несчастью для неё, я не имел ответных чувств к ней.

О Юми же я вовсе не думал долгое время, я даже не интересовался ею особо. Но как некоторые говорят — сердцу не прикажешь. И вот я здесь с баннерами и аватаркой Юми.

Я никогда не понимал почему та или иная девушка мне нравится больше, чем другая. Поэтому я до сих пор немного удивлён, что лично для меня Юми сбила с трона симпатии Майю.

Типа, кто бы не полюбил девушку, что грубая снаружи, но нежная внутри? Главное, чтобы она показала свою подобную сторону

spoilers.title: Глобальная любовь к Юми
spoilers.html:
В любом случае! Я бы добавил, что Юми нравится многим игрокам в ЛиЛ глобально, а не только русским. Типа, ты и сам мог заметить, что Юми победила в голосовании, которое буквально на днях устроил Селебус, да и в группе Косатика, если ты там есть, когда он около месяца назад устроил голосование Королевы Кумон-ми (какое же ебанутое название у города), Юми крайне высоко зашла, встав в топ-3 и проиграв только Аяне и Майе, обе из которых тоже нравятся многим на глобальном уровне. Поэтому ябы сказал, что Юми многим нравится по двум главным причинам:
1. Юми всегда была в стороне от того, чтобы напрыгивать на член Сенсея вот так с ходу, как это делали остальные девушки, но при этом сюжетно Юми давно показывала признаки того, что между ней и Сенсеем что-то было, будь то до начала цикла, что увековечилось в её памяти, или внутри цикла в качестве затуманенных воспоминаний. Ну и теперь она оказалась в этом RAS-отряде вместе с Аяне, Макото и Акирой, что уже автоматически повышает её интерес для рядового игрока в ЛиЛ.
2. Юми несомненно сексуальна. Думаю, во многом это даже превосходит первый пункт. Однако те, кто так далеко зашёл в ЛиЛ, вряд ли уже только членом думают, ибо игра не про дрочку вовсе.

posts.content_html_raw:
VoidExile I forgot to respond to the time you mentioned trying to translate the text on Molly's hoodie.

It's a meta joke with at least 3 layers.

1) Phonetically, it reads as "Hiragana". Hiragana is the alphabet used for general Japanese when they aren't compressing whole words into unique symbols called Kanji. (Hiragana in Hiragana is ひらがな, in Kanji is 平ｶﾅ)

2) Orthographically, it's written in Katakana, which is the alphabet used mostly for words that are borrowed from other languages. Hamburger would be Hanbāgā or ハンバーガー.

3) The irony of japanese explicitly borrowing a japanese word to read it in english probably makes the weeb who wrote it really happy.

shmurfer said:
VoidExile I forgot to respond to the time you mentioned trying to translate the text on Molly's hoodie.

It's a meta joke with at least 3 layers.

1) Phonetically, it reads as "Hiragana". Hiragana is the alphabet used for general Japanese when they aren't compressing whole words into unique symbols called Kanji. (Hiragana in Hiragana is ひらがな, in Kanji is 平ｶﾅ)

2) Orthographically, it's written in Katakana, which is the alphabet used mostly for words that are borrowed from other languages. Hamburger would be Hanbāgā or ハンバーガー.

3) The irony of japanese explicitly borrowing a japanese word to read it in english probably makes the weeb who wrote it really happy.

Well it's essentially the age old choice between having something done for you (for a price) vs. having to do it yourself (for an even higher price sometimes) but having the freedom to do it yourself, the way you want to.

Like people who order their food regularly vs. people who cook for themselves.
Or learning how to sew up holes in your clothes or do some handiwork at home vs. having to rely on paid workers to do it for you.

At the end of the day, society is based on sharing expertise and knowledge so that the community as a whole benefits overall.

Now, to conclude this awkward and botched metaphor, the community in this case is the lilcord and the GOD creator expert would be Selebus, who is the obvious go-to person for this.
Sure, whoever is looking forward to all this, could get KK, download the cards, learn how to set up some decent lighting effects, use their creative noggin and render away. Just like I could buy all the ingredients for a really good Neapolitan pizza and bake one myself instead of ordering it from my favorite pizza place. Would it turn out exactly as good? Probably not, but it would satisfy that urge. Would it cost me less? Maybe, but not necessarily? Do I really want to invest my time, effort and practice to really do that, when I could just put in an order in 30 seconds and wait for 30 minutes? Most likely also no.

And besides, he is still the mind behind this. There is possibly going to be some content outside of non-canon renders that do benefit from him not only having the KK skills but also the story insights to create interesting tidbits.

So, to give them some credit, I don't think the lilcord is as naive and braindead as some make them out to be, Sel is not really shafting them. He is giving them what they want, obviously.
Is it what I want? No, I would be happy to cook my own dinner and instead have the effort put into what I think Sel should be focused on instead. But I accept that I am in the minority. He will look at his paying clientele's feedback, not ours. Which makes sense.

Should we therefore condone the lilcord as tasteless, uncultured swine that are happy to be fed slop because they don't know any better? Probably yes.
But I don't care enough to really get riled up about it.
And there is still a chance that the event might still turn out to be an interesting change of pace and not a total waste of time.

DeanNoriko said:
Well it's essentially the age old choice between having something done for you (for a price) vs. having to do it yourself (for an even higher price sometimes) but having the freedom to do it yourself, the way you want to.
Like people who order their food regularly vs. people who cook for themselves.
Or learning how to sew up holes in your clothes or do some handiwork at home vs. having to rely on paid workers to do it for you.
At the end of the day, society is based on sharing expertise and knowledge so that the community as a whole benefits overall.
Now, to conclude this awkward and botched metaphor, the community in this case is the lilcord and the
GOD
creator
expert would be Selebus, who is the obvious go-to person for this.
Sure, whoever is looking forward to all this, could get KK, download the cards, learn how to set up some decent lighting effects, use their creative noggin and render away. Just like I could buy all the ingredients for a really good Neapolitan pizza and bake one myself instead of ordering it from my favorite pizza place. Would it turn out exactly as good? Probably not, but it would satisfy that urge. Would it cost me less? Maybe, but not necessarily? Do I really want to invest my time, effort and practice to really do that, when I could just put in an order in 30 seconds and wait for 30 minutes? Most likely also no.
And besides, he is still the mind behind this. There is possibly going to be some content outside of non-canon renders that do benefit from him not only having the KK skills but also the story insights to create interesting tidbits.
So, to give them some credit, I don't think the lilcord is as naive and braindead as some make them out to be, Sel is not really shafting them. He is giving them what they want, obviously.
Is it what I want? No, I would be happy to cook my own dinner and instead have the effort put into what I think Sel should be focused on instead. But I accept that I am in the minority. He will look at his paying clientele's feedback, not ours. Which makes sense.
Should we therefore condone the lilcord as tasteless, uncultured swine that are happy to be fed slop because they don't know any better? Probably yes.
But I don't care enough to really get riled up about it.
And there is still a chance that the
event
might still turn out to be an interesting change of pace and not a total waste of time.

So some of the grief she felt had been converted to anger instead of the intense sadness she could have felt.
Even long in the past when Sekai and Akira's brother died he and Ami were likely not there to see it so they don't have that lingering trauma of someone dying near them.
I don't know about Chika's mom but Chika and Chinami seem completely fine. Miku however? She seem fine... until there is a loud sound.
Kaori seem to have wiped the entire thing from her memory and is all fucked up because of it, but what we see is a cheerful fine person.

I can't exactly imagine knowing that all of your class have been brutally murdered and the love of your life have disappeared on you more times than you can remember does any good for your mental state, so the final mystery "winner" of this thing would be the original Maya. Surprise! Akira's trauma can't even compare yet.
God damnit Maki! You have no idea how real those incest jokes of yours are but it's all a joke to you!
So as soon as actual love gets thrown into the picture, Maki becomes a stuttering mess?

If you are willing to cannibalize someone, you don't like them. Got it.

I kill them outside because it was an accident and they were in my way. I do not think I take pleasure in killing them but I don't take displeasure in it either.
Tried to "start over" at a school away from home a couple years ago. Short semi messy post bedridden Ami ark can commence! (but I still don't trust her and she will have to crawl out from the grave).

I just want to point out that "commissioning" a piano arrangement of "Hallelujah" doesn't mean you own it. It's Leonard Cohen's song. His estate owns the music. Wtf is she saying? Has she gone insane from lust?

Yasu accidentally discover the location of where her (former) teacher lives.

Dorm visit to Chika. She says she's tired of working at the mall but she doesn't work there anymore... Unless she has two jobs now.

Wtf is that Ayane option? Have sex on Sana's bed?

NULLWIZARD said:
I wrote a small mod that lets you skip the affection/lust point grind without having to go through the tedium of typing in cheat codes or having your save labelled with the cheater flag.

View attachment 1901303

Features:
  • Sets all girls' affection and lust points to a value X unless they were already higher than X
  • Can set a specific girl's love/lust points
  • Written to be future-proof (i.e. will automatically work for any new girls, you will never need to update the mod)
  • Enables the developer console
Usage Instructions:
  • Download the attached file
    • Note: if you get sent to a new tab with a bunch of text, just right click and hit "Save as" and name it as z_set_love_lust.rpy
  • Move into the folder named "game" (found inside the folder that you launch Lessons in Love from)
  • Load a save and open the developer console with Shift + O
  • Press Enter a few times until you can see the ">" symbol in the top left of the screen
  • To update all girls' love and lust: type setLoveAndLust(X) and press Enter(for an example, see the image below)
    • Note: X must be an integer (aka whole number)
  • To update a specific girl's love or lust, for example Ami: type "ami_love += X" and/or "ami_lust += X" without the quotation marks and then press Enter.

Some pretty basic tips regarding lighting and shading:

- For Shadows, go to System (top left corner) > Scene Effects. Then scroll down until you find the Miscellaneous section. You should see where it says Shadow Type and their respective densities. Set the Shadow Type to Perfect, Smooth Shadows, make the overall Shadow Color completely black, then crank the Shadow Density up as high as it will go. You can adjust accordingly from there.

- For Lighting, Shaders make all the difference. Default KK lighting isn’t really that good… You can find Shaders at the very top of Scene Effects, where I mentioned before. Click where it says Shade, then from there, choose the Shader you like best. Personally, I like to use either ‘MOD_A’ or ‘zmr_001_LUT32’. They’re good for making renders look better. ‘xukmi’ shaders also work really well for visual effects. Just use the item search bar (the magnifying glass icon) and type in ‘xukmi’. Play around with the effects. (Use Material Editor to access the sliders for xukmi effects btw.)

- Be sure to go to System > Char Lighting to control the location of your central lighting before rendering your snapshot. It can make all the difference in the world, because sometimes the central lighting can be way off to the side and out of view. Adjust it accordingly.

- Lens flares and Colored Shadows also help a lot to give your renders some extra decoration. Again, use the item search bar to find them.

And that’s pretty much it.

I’m still practicing at this, myself, but am learning more with every attempt. Hopefully this can help in some way.

Keep it up!

spoilers.title: Lighting and Shading tips
spoilers.html:
- For Shadows, go to System (top left corner) > Scene Effects. Then scroll down until you find the Miscellaneous section. You should see where it says Shadow Type and their respective densities. Set the Shadow Type to Perfect, Smooth Shadows, make the overall Shadow Color completely black, then crank the Shadow Density up as high as it will go. You can adjust accordingly from there.

- For Lighting, Shaders make all the difference. Default KK lighting isn’t really that good… You can find Shaders at the very top of Scene Effects, where I mentioned before. Click where it says Shade, then from there, choose the Shader you like best. Personally, I like to use either ‘MOD_A’ or ‘zmr_001_LUT32’. They’re good for making renders look better. ‘xukmi’ shaders also work really well for visual effects. Just use the item search bar (the magnifying glass icon) and type in ‘xukmi’. Play around with the effects. (Use Material Editor to access the sliders for xukmi effects btw.)

- Be sure to go to System > Char Lighting to control the location of your central lighting before rendering your snapshot. It can make all the difference in the world, because sometimes the central lighting can be way off to the side and out of view. Adjust it accordingly.

- Lens flares and Colored Shadows also help a lot to give your renders some extra decoration. Again, use the item search bar to find them.

Why even do the Dorm Wars at this point? They were pretty good the first few times, but after a while, it’s gotten to the point where it just feels stale.

I wouldn’t mind at all if the Dorm Wars took a hiatus and something else was put in its place. For instance, the Camping Trip was a good example of doing something different for the majority of the update. The change in scenery was unexpectedly pleasant and it shook some things up temporarily.

Just something, anything new, I would be open-minded for. The Dorm Wars just doesn’t really get me hyped like the first two did, especially since not a single one except for the very first one ever actually delivered any sort of reward for the winner.

The fact that even Sel is like ‘fuck it’ and is leaving the contests and face-offs up to subscriber polls shows he is just as apathetic about the Dorm Wars as anyone else. It’s another bump in the road. Another obstacle. One that ‘has to happen’ because tradition demands it. But it really doesn’t.

It depends on other flags they may have set up. For instance, events that require the Ami romance path will call for the "amifingered" flag. It seems to have been so every time Selebus does it, but not everything is that clear cut.

Regardless, just marking an event as "seen" does not automatically make the game treat your playthrough as if you have chosen that path. It depends on what Selebus will call upon for when choosing how to implement his variations in the future. That's the one way to make sure that flags aren't messed up unfortunately. You could modify them yourself and luck out, but you'll still miss all those events tbh (as replay doesn't always show everything either).

OH FUCK! And it's Chika too! Please don't let their friendship be ruined over some misunderstanding! That would be fucked!

And what about her previous house...? There could be more at stake here than their friendships. Yumi might end up losing access to it and if Chika was really petty, she might report Yumi to the police or something.

Ah great. More crabs.

That first conversation between Io and Uta after the Io rape. Yeah it was certainly different. If you didn't do it she says it's the first time confronting the fear didn't end in tragedy. If you did it she says Uta will be much happier not knowing what happened but she kinda implies it in both dialogues but make that more true in the post rape one. Welp. Separate save made for that path.

Uta's thinks she's in love with him, huh? Tell me something less obvious.
Wait, Io didn't know this has been happening for a while? Hmm, it sorta checks out but I don't remember... as always.
Do you think in a roundabout way that Io gave herself up to him because Uta weren't showing she loved him earlier?
So Uta absolutely refuses a throuple, even if it's Io? I don't understand it but it's a gender and sexuality thing. I may feel different(same way Uta feels) if I had a strong male friendship and we both liked the same person.
Having those cringes now that Io is confident he does want sex more than anything.
Wow, that section felt a bit shorter because Io wasn't confident he wanted sex.

Did the world decide to put a lock on Tsuneyo's memories again after the nudity incident?

Wait... oh don't tell me I could have taken the shampoo from the reset after all. Just not visit the dorm's twice and I would have been fine.
Oh fuck, I could have...

What, is Sana an attack dog now?

Well fuck me I guess. That shampoo thing was just a illusion of choice situation. How much longer is he planning to hold onto that and should I find a spot to URM in the bottle after all? Would I need to flip some flag for the dorms visit during the reset to avoid any weird conflicts too? If anyone knows, please let me know.

Mystery girl being as ominous as possible.
Wtf is that light...?
Uuuuuuuuuummmm what? Three different moons.
What is happening right now...?
Okay wtf was that? Now all three are back like nothing happened.

Yumi is the only one not interrupting? But... Sana?

Makoto affection and lust are both at 69. Hmmm... Happy little accidents. Nice.

No but seriously, that was just odd. Now they are all gonna pretend nothing happened.

Ami: "Yay! Murder!" uhmm... no?

I can't tell if Ami is just in denial or intentionally acting the way she does to unsettle Niki to drop the idea or something like that.

DAMNIT SEKAI! Let Ami speak for herself.
Is her dead mother manipulating her or what is going on there?

Are any of you intentionally replaying the game for the main reason of seeing what it would be like if Ami wasn't sexually involved with him?
I may have to make a separate batch of save files just for a red path playthrough. Wonder how long that playthrough can take and what would be skippable.

What could possibly happen to make Ami reject Niki and Noriko from moving in or whatever? She seem almost convinced, but surely it can't be that easy right? How would the game turn out if there were four people living there?
She's actually willing to give it a try? I didn't think that would work at all...
Oh, here we go. Is she hearing what's being said? Is she preparing to do something?
That evil smirk... Oh don't tell me that's what she's planning. She's gonna torment Niki, steal him from her and make everything inconvenient for her isn't she? Barging in in the middle of sex Kirin style?

What the actual fuck? That's a weird start to a happy event...
Also since when can Moyo speak?
Are they referring to Maya's box(es)? Wonder when we will get to know what's in there...
World's worst comedy show?

Reading backwards is annoying...

Nao's affection again...

Hi JOSEPH.
Stop it JOSEPH.

Of course Chika haven't been responding to Yumi. Because she wants to believe and interpret things wrong and not confronting the problem head on.
And fucking typical behavior. "Oh I'm not gonna give you the reason why I'm mad at you, fuck off out of here while I continue to believe my own fabricated story because I'm a BITCH!"
Chinami is unironically smarter about his situation than Chika is. Love is blinding.
It says a lot about a person's friendship when they take one misunderstanding to heart and want nothing to do with that friend anymore. Real friendships don't end because of one situation that could have been a misunderstanding. And if they do, then friendships are fake and have always been fake.

Every little thing Yumi said IS true. But of course Chika would go and say she doesn't think it is. She's fallen so far in such a short time...
This is the kind of misunderstanding I hate. When a misunderstanding leads to conflict that could have serious consequences.

It would be so easy for Yumi to tell Chika and Chinami to be silent while she makes the speaker call, then ask Akira if they kissed that night and why they went back to his room, which I still don't fucking understand why she doesn't confess the reason to as there are multiple people who can vouch for her.
She failed. Instantly. She didn't fucking ask him the questions to clear up her truths, instead she gave him the opportunity to come up with lies... I am so disappointed at her. But I am furious at Chika. She almost fucking killed her best friend over a misunderstanding.

Of course both their affections went down... They should go back up tho.

The mc could probably "fix" the situation between Yumi and Chika by admitting to sleeping with someone else and denying sleeping with Yumi, maybe even confirm it with a phone call. Then she will be distracted by someone else instead and probably forget about Yumi because he actually confessed to one relationship and denied her, implying he's telling the truth. Of course he's not going to do any of that and it's probably not the right course of action anyway in his situation.
I feel like my idea just fell apart as Chika just said even if his story checks out, Yumi isn't absolved of it. And yeah, Yumi did admit to a couple things.

Grounding Chinami? Isn't she already like, permanently grounded?

Of COURSE she would interpret it like that! Chika is fucking insane in the head, I swear! "There were a bunch of other girls in my room that night too" "You fucked an entire room full of girls while I was bawling my eyes out in a public bathroom?"

Ah fuck... She/they keep saying things that makes it seem like the situation is worse than just a misunderstanding. Well, because it is.

The long overdue conversation. Just wish it took place while she isn't in an emotionally high and blinded state. Talking about your problems moments after an argument don't work.
Oh god... not her too. It's the Ami insanity and now it's infected Chika. They are always so hard to talk to when they are like that.
Okay, NOW she really is in that state.

Wait until she finds out his fucking his "daughter", her favorite idol, half the class and that same idol is planning to move in with him.

Bruh! When they say you should breath to calm down, I don't think it's suppose to be THAT effective! Dev really exaggerated that part for comedic effect.
3 different songs in the course of 2 events that feel like one long event. It's nothing new but it's 3 completely different songs. Distress, sadness and happiness.

Now that's a familiar image. Feel like I've seen that on site banners here forever.

She is coping so fucking hard right now. That breathing thing didn't actually work, she just pretended it did. She's still furious inside. I guess the revelations pushed her so far into the corner of despair that she went all the way back to being perfectly fine.

...I guess Chika has rabies. But doesn't he also have that since he kissed her?
EXCUSE ME!? +1000 AFFECTION!? Maya doesn't have shit on Chika, does she? Or I guess "didn't she" would be the right wording here.
Still fucking weird how Yumi's affection took a hit. And I totally expected one of them to confess to the rape kiss but they both somehow avoided saying that. And while not necessarily relevant, they avoided the Nodoka thing too.

Oh god... this is already sad. I would say this is just a sickness but I mean, this IS a girl with immunodeficiency so I imagine fevers are quite terrifying.

Wow, that was a sudden reaction from Chinami finding out about his "other" daughter.

"Papa's special soup" My mind has been in the gutter for too long, help.

Chinami broke character... She can say "me" after all.

Tsukasa had options similar to this... And of course that also makes you miss the event. Are we absolutely sure following the green path and not missing any events is the way to go? Is this just a game about embracing every creepy fetish known to man to get the good ending? That IS what this is, right? Green path = good ending, bad beginning/midgame?

I am still confused by that Maya image... Her face implies "I'm having sex right now" but you don't actually see that and it keeps getting brought up.

Once again, Chinami proving why she's just too smart and reckless at the same time.

Surprised he decided to give Chinami his name so "early".

How does she fucking know what a lolicon is?
Of course it was Yumi...
She's fucking dangerous dude! Such a tease!

Uh oh, here comes trouble.
I'm... starting to think this family is clueless.
Oh... it's because her affection is currently so high. It has to be that. She probably rationalizes it in her head like they are already married.

Thanks, I love soviet books. That was a joke that would go like this: "in soviet Russian, books read you" It's a very funny joke as you can see.

Touka blends in so perfectly in the porn shop... Is she trying to learn about sex or what?

God fucking damnit. NordVPN ad... The only other sponsor besides Raid that's everywhere.

Oh yeah... and I bet her mother got all the toys thanks to Maki. Probably got an entire room dedicated to just that.

Seiza-style sitting really makes you look so much taller, huh? Makoto could be Touka's little sister like this. 0.3 difference in height doesn't do that much.

I like THIS Makoto, my goodness!
I find it strange she was tormenting Touka and being that open with her, yet she slams her head in frustration that more keeps getting interested in him. I don't know about you, but if I found out I'm in a never ending time loop, I might try to convince myself that jealousy is completely unwarranted when time is infinite.
Chinami rose. Io fell(why?). Chika took a nose dive.(part of her probably fell off the balcony... funny joke).

So much here, and I would need to think about it for a bit—but the interesting big-picture thing that really interested me was your thoughts on the terminals.

We’ve been largely assuming that the terminals are sequential, representing the generations in the game — so 22 is the parents (Yuu, Miu, etc.), 23 is the present group, and 24 is the next generation (Himawari) — you’ve suggested that the terminals are actually layers of reality. I love givemeabeer ’s take, that they’re like shells in a computer system—that the top shell (in your theory, terminal 24, right?) is so to say the objective reality of the game, while t23 is the “user interface,” the part of the computer system we interact with, while each layer above that (that is, the lower numbered terminals) is another layer of abstraction, resting inside the one above it.

So by that thinking, would, say, the safe room sequence with adult Sana, be a memory from reality (t25)? It’s pretty hallucinatory — so our hero (Akira/Sensei/Nozomu) is dealing with a psychotic break?

We’ve been largely assuming that the terminals are sequential, representing the generations in the game — so 22 is the parents (Yuu, Miu, etc.), 23 is the present group, and 24 is the next generation (Himawari) — you’ve suggested that the terminals are actually layers of reality. I love

’s take, that they’re like
shells

Kudos on the effort, but man, what a ride. It's just too long for me to review the whole thing (I have read it though), so I'll give an example:
"Akira is actually an avatar of Nozomu that is trying to understand love", but "Akira is also Yuu", and "Nozomu is trying to learn to overcome the difficulties of his real life" such as being the son of Yuu, and sibling to Akira, "which are both himself" you see the bootstrap paradox here? He's trying to overcome what only started existing as tools for him to overcome something.

My opinion, and I am a bit to blame for this as well sometimes, but I don't think the game is supposed to be that tangled of a mess in the end. To take the words from Selebus himself in the past:
There is some complexity obviously, and to theorize is fun even when it becomes silly, but yeah, I think things tend to be at the simpler side than not. Like Maya's boxes likely just carrying her notes of each reset, or how the mythology behind each god is likely to be, you know, made up - in the sense that they're only real as long as someone believes in them.
I could be wrong, and certainly not everything you said can or should be dismissed, but overall that's my opinion. Pareidolia said it best when he explained that if Akira was stronger, they'd have never even met. And multiple characters tell him that he's a fool to basically just walk around letting whatever "divine" bullshit take hold of him. Things are likely to be simpler than they appear.

Kudos on the effort, but man, what a ride. It's just too long for me to review the whole thing (I have read it though), so I'll give an example:
Spoiler:
further thoughts
"Akira is actually an avatar of Nozomu that is trying to understand love", but "Akira is also Yuu", and "Nozomu is trying to learn to overcome the difficulties of his real life" such as being the son of Yuu, and sibling to Akira, "which are both himself"
you see the bootstrap paradox here? He's trying to overcome what only started existing as tools for him to overcome something.
My opinion, and I am a bit to blame for this as well sometimes, but I don't think the game is supposed to be that tangled of a mess in the end. To take the words from Selebus himself in the past:
Spoiler:
what Lessons in Love is
There is some complexity obviously, and to theorize is fun even when it becomes silly, but yeah, I think things tend to be at the simpler side than not. Like Maya's boxes likely just carrying her notes of each reset, or how the mythology behind each god is likely to be, you know, made up - in the sense that they're only real as long as someone believes in them.
I could be wrong, and certainly not everything you said can or should be dismissed, but overall that's my opinion. Pareidolia said it best when he explained that if Akira was stronger, they'd have never even met. And multiple characters tell him that he's a fool to basically just walk around letting whatever "divine" bullshit take hold of him. Things are likely to be simpler than they appear.

spoilers.title: further thoughts
spoilers.html:
"Akira is actually an avatar of Nozomu that is trying to understand love", but "Akira is also Yuu", and "Nozomu is trying to learn to overcome the difficulties of his real life" such as being the son of Yuu, and sibling to Akira, "which are both himself" you see the bootstrap paradox here? He's trying to overcome what only started existing as tools for him to overcome something.

My opinion, and I am a bit to blame for this as well sometimes, but I don't think the game is supposed to be that tangled of a mess in the end. To take the words from Selebus himself in the past:
There is some complexity obviously, and to theorize is fun even when it becomes silly, but yeah, I think things tend to be at the simpler side than not. Like Maya's boxes likely just carrying her notes of each reset, or how the mythology behind each god is likely to be, you know, made up - in the sense that they're only real as long as someone believes in them.

So many people in past couple months alone talking about how URM said there was a choice and now they're missing events when the split was to decide whether a person has missed an event in the first place.
Click to expand...
People need to be better educated in that, I agree. It's probably because they believe that by "choosing" a path when URM calls for it, they're gaining everything related to the path, but that is not so.
For instance, you could choose to watch the Himawari scene on "post nut clarity" through URM even without the necessary Ayane points, but that would not give you the Ayane points, it would simply force the scene to play. Flags coming from the Himawari scene would be granted to you, if I recall correctly, but not the prerequisite for them.

That was a simpler example, but if you take someone forcing an Ami path scene to play without the "amifingered" flag, well, since that is a prerequisite, it would not be granted to the player upon seeing the scene - which means that the game would interpret it as the player not being on Ami's path, even if a scene from it was played. That is because Selebus programmed it in such a way that the "amifingered" flag from ages ago is still being called, instead of another more recent flag.
But then again that's not URM's fault, but the user's for not understanding what they're doing. In that case, they should just ask us for help, as one did recently regarding the amifingered and good homie paths.

For instance, you could choose to watch the Himawari scene on "post nut clarity" through URM even without the necessary Ayane points, but that would not give you the Ayane points, it would simply force the scene to play. Flags coming from the Himawari scene would be granted to you, if I recall correctly, but not the prerequisite for them.

That was a simpler example, but if you take someone forcing an Ami path scene to play without the "amifingered" flag, well, since that is a prerequisite, it would not be granted to the player upon seeing the scene - which means that the game would interpret it as the player not being on Ami's path, even if a scene from it was played. That is because Selebus programmed it in such a way that the "amifingered" flag from ages ago is still being called, instead of another more recent flag.

The danger comes when there is a unique flag set based on the path that was taken. For instance when 0.46 released, that scene in particular ended up with mayablock being removed if you watched the Himawari scene, and being left enabled if you just saw the regular scene. (fixed in 0.47 with autopatch and both paths setting the same variables)

In that instance, URM'ing the Himawari scene and committing instead of rolling back would result in mayablock being removed from your game. If Sel actually intended this, he could also query later whether ayane_love < 3000 and mayablock == False and if that returned True, you'd be a cheater and Sel could do with that information whatever he wished.


Looking is fine as long as rollback / previous saves exist and are used. Otherwise it's a gamble and losing once can cause unintended behavior that you'll almost never figure out since it can't happen in regular gameplay.

Precisely why I didn't even bother responding. I've dealt with plenty of their type before. Doesn't matter how much effort you put in to point out the inconsistencies, won't ever acknowledge the flaws in their logic.

Beyond delusional that they think their theories are undeniable truth and they seem to think they know the story better than Selebus himself.

For example "you did it" isn't some overly complicated secret trying to point at Sensei killing some unborn child that we may or may not even know the true identity of. It just simply represents Sekai, and Akira's self-blame for her death. It's shown in game multiple times how much her death affected him to the point it took him countless resets to be able to even acknowledge openly that it even happened. He believed it was his fault because he didn't run away with her when she asked him to, he felt he betrayed her. It's implied she died soon after that, presumably not able to cope with being in a loveless marriage anymore and killed herself and took Nozomu out with her, potentially even saving Akira from further abuse from his brother.

Sekai is the most direct and obvious option for the meaning behind the name "you did it"
It's a secret that is slowly revealed to us from the beginning, making us constantly wonder what it means and what could Akira have done to make him manifest a being whose whole existence is to exert blame on himself? Did he rape someone, murder someone? Our imaginations began seeking out the worst possible explanations, only to end up being something that he didn't even mean to happen intentionally. He blames himself, because all he had to do was take her hand and leave with her, but he was a coward.

And those are the kinds of mistakes that truly break us and make us curse fate and all of its cruelty.
It's excellent storytelling.

A lot of the parallels being pointed out in the OG post are meaningless. It's feels like that person would go outside and when noticing that the sky is blue, they would say something like:
"You know what else is blue? AYANE'S EYES. AYANE DIED AND CREATED THE SKY BECAUSE SHE LOVED AKIRA AND WANTED HIM TO REMEMBER HER. BOOM YOU'RE WELCOME SELEBUS."

I can't be assed to engage with it anymore XD

I did a search for your posts and many of the regulars, including myself, have reacted to them - when not fully replying (as DeSkel seems to have done a couple of times). The thing is that, unless someone poses a direct question, we won't always engage with a reply if we don't have anything to add, someone else has already said what we were going to, or, as it happens sometimes, we focus our efforts on replying to someone else (when the thread is very active).

Regarding your proficiency in English, there is absolutely no issue - we can all understand you fine.
Regarding "Enjo Kousai", we don't know. There have been many theories in the past, but none of them have been conclusive. Iirc aramaug was one of the last ones to provide a full analysis of the scene, but I'll share my thoughts in an abridged manner.
There are three supernatural things happening here, the first is the distortion of current Uta being replaced by wizard Uta. Then you have a Sekai that watched from behind a tree. Then you have a shift from wizard Uta (which is an aggressor to Akira's current state) to a wizard Maya that is there to help him go back to his normal state (thus being helpful to him).

My current take is that all of this is Akira's mind. This is based on Pareidolia's explanation that his work during Spring was providing Akira with someone to blame, when in actual fact it was all Akira himself. I think Akira simply saw Uta in wizard form because he's a pedophile and he had masturbated to her picture in that form so many times.

The "Sekai" that watches behind a tree is a metaphor to the Predator that groomed him watching him grooming someone else as a distant but active influence. I tend to see it this way because the real Sekai has no reason to hide behind a tree. She'd be egging him on right to his face.

Lastly, the Maya that shows up is basically saying that everything is under his control "you want this to stop? all you had to do was ask". This is also what Pareidolia explains to him when he says that if Akira was stronger they'd have never even met. And this is proved when Sana rejects Pegasus and nothing comes of it. Maya is the representation of his safe space, his ally, the wizard that he had sex with and yet it was somehow "consensual" and "healthy" - she shows up to give him control back over his delusions.

With this, I'm not saying that supernatural influence does not exist, but I am saying that at this moment I'm thinking that maybe it wasn't the case (much like the recent gnome stuff during Christmas). If we were to consider that it was all divine stuff, then Maya would either be narrator Maya, Himawari or Pareidolia playing good cop to his own bad cop.
Those are my current thoughts, but, again, we just don't know.

Suffering gives us perspective in our modern closed-off lives. It helps us appreciate the good things, no matter how small or fleeting. Everything has a balance.

By subjecting ourselves to fictional tragic experiences, it shows us that things could be much much worse in our real life and helps keeps us from becoming jaded and bitter.

There are many people today that refuse to acknowledge the bad, constantly seeking out things that make them feel good and neglecting to accept that there must be a down to counter every up. And before they know it, every little molehill becomes a mountain of an issue to them. Every little thing sets them off.

By accepting the darkness in humanity and staring it in the face, the good things will appear even brighter.

Attention please. This is me saying that I am done (for now). I am going on a long break from this game. Sorry, I just can't do it. Everything felt so pointless and from this point: Yumi showed up next to Ayane and past Maya right before the rooftop reset, I enabled skip unseen and just rushed through everything. So I have no read everything but I've seen things in fast forward. This was a decision I made to force demotivate myself not to keep going. Perhaps one day I will return, but for now, I have a minor headache, I want to play a couple different games, I want to sleep and I want get my mind off everything.
I could elaborate on my decision through specific questions but right now, I just want to be done with this. So from the point I mention within the spoiler that I enabled unseen text, feel free to tell me anything negative that happens after. Spare no details. Or just... don't say anything at all. It's not like I will be back any time soon and I will probably have reset to a point where I won't care for a while. I don't know, this is all zero effort rambling at this point but as I said, I don't want to be here right now.

Since the chapter isn't done yet, I can't really post the completed data yet, or more like I won't. But rest assured that this game made me write like 600-700k characters worth of text which is like 10 times my previous best on a large game.

Day 73(Finale?) Character count 13740.
I'm glad to see the timeline fuckery is still going strong.
What turned out to be a good dream turned into a lesbian... nightmare? Well, she's not gonna forget kissing Ami now.

Sekai is the very talkative kind and Akira is the quiet type. Don't think we have ever had this much dialogue from her. I'm just waiting for her to take the initiative, but the chances of that happening are questionable.

Damn dude. The Ami from this version must be going insane for a completely different reason having to watch him fuck other girls while she can't get to join in.

In the middle of all the chaos and golden reaction, the game throws you right into nonsensical narrations.

I still find it weird Maya's birthday firework celebration scene had such an impact on him, or any of you for that matter. I didn't feel much of anything during that scene. Guess I just don't find the romanticism in it?

Oof, Maya slaps Ayane.

Maya's scarf! I'm not sure how that's going to make future Maya trust Ayane, but it will certainly raise an eyebrow.
OHHHHH! I get it! Niki and Noriko had to show Akira physical items to make him remember! If that really is Maya, she might remember a whole lot of things from the past however many years Maya has been around.

Well that confirms it. Those dreaded boxes she has made him carry so many times in the past, it's information about all the loops she's been through. Gotta say, it's not the most shocking thing that could be contained in those boxes, but it certainly explains a good bit.

Maya coming in with the second slap! Maya is savage, huh?

Chika has been damned. "If I can't have one(boyfriend) in this world, I'll be damned if I share the one I actually do have in Yumi's world!"

Think it's safe to assume that there are now four "rooftop apocalypse" members. Just that they are somehow split between three realities.

This Makoto is dreaming of the actual future. Strange.

Sigma grindset... bruh.

Wish Miku still dressed as a gyaru.
I feel like between season 3 and season 4, gyaru Miku got a lot more... gen z or alpha.
I'm not sure what this group of three have to do with the time travel but perhaps people liked gyaru Miku so much that they wanted more of her like me? And this was the best way to make it happen without making a care package.

Maybe Karin is one of this Sensei's lovers? Karin is attractive, she's kind and sporty. So maybe he is trying to build something. Or maybe he just really likes football so much he would jump at the idea of watching it with someone who gets it.

Answering your phone can be scary when you don't know what it's about. If you want to reach someone, keep sending them short messages that appear on their lock screen. For example: "Time travel, time loops, reset, this is Yumi, where are you right now!?"

Oh god, please no! I'm actually starting to sort of fear what Kaori does now.
FUUUUUUUCK! Now I have to worry about Yumi! How the fuck am I suppose to rate Kaori now!? It's three different kinds of people! Yumi probably got the fucking Nodoka treatment! It's the fucking Gods I'm upset at.
I can't even pinpoint what part of that made me upset. I think it's just because it's Yumi and I wanted her to be part of this because it makes her seem more special which I want her to be. Now it's hard to focus because of worry...
I would have much rather had Makoto get taken by the God's than Yumi. This is irritating as fuck.

And now it's younger Maya. That really is a huge size difference... for obvious reasons.
And this means the time traveling isn't limited to just those millions of years of time looping, but can send you back all the way here.

The chair scene... It was Maya all along. Based on what I read about this scene, it's going to be Ami. And this might be what original Maya warned Ayane about with Ami going around killing and torturing everyone. So, she might be about to live through what happened to her again.
We don't even get to see it yet. I was right about it being Ami...
You know it's gonna feel real horrible if that scarf Ayane is gonna give Maya back somehow gives her back all her memories, implying that she was just reset and not replaced.
Man, of course this reset wasn't gonna be kindhearted and confusing. It's no "lessons in love" without forcing trauma down the players throat. Horrible. First it was Yumi getting the Nodoka treatment which we still don't know what it was, now it's fake Maya getting the chair orgasm rape treatment that the dev decided to have sit in our heads longer while we have to watch Makoto go through another symposium or whatever. And knowing how this has been going, we are probably gonna see Maya and Ayane's pov next.

Okay, that's a distraction! Makoto's dad is ALSO alive! I see what's going on here! This is the timeline where people didn't die!
Of course she doesn't get the satisfaction to talk to her dad. Instead, Nao shows up and triggers another symposium.

That is just not an environment you should be growing up in... You would think this family would noise isolate every room like all hell.

Oh god, that's disturbing... A faceless clone of yourself standing in the dark... No, writing that down makes it sound 10 times more disturbing!

Why are so many being tied to chairs lately? I mean, 2 is still more than 1.

Did Makoto just fucking die?
If she went home when she died, did Yumi also get killed and go home?

Makoto and/or Akira jinxed themselves by saying they would be together. I expected something like that to happen, but game took it a step further.

HUH? Ayane just went poof like original Maya did! But then that means... Ayane got pulled back to the timeline with original Maya and the original future Maya have got a similar treatment?
Miku too? WHY? Is EVERYONE gonna get that treatment?
They are! And look, that's the picture! That's the picture! The update picture! (0.45)
And HOPE is back for some reason.
Yasu took a little while, it's like (I'm assuming) HOPE didn't want

So what does this mean for the future? Everyone but Maya, Ami and Makoto somehow got vaporized or something and then user 2 (whatever that important user is) got infected by some virus and was "removed".

I feel like all Maya really was was an endless sea of memories and experiences. That's probably why her disappearance hit me so badly. So to see Sekai say that memories aren't everything is... questionable. I just sort of saw Maya as a really important person on account of being the only database for all things time looping. And that gave her an absurd amount of value.

Oh boy... Let me guess. This is the rooftop Nodoka that ran into Kaori and all her memories are intact! Dude, WHAT DOES THIS MEEEEAN!?!?!?
It is! Am I happy!? WHY!? It's Nodoka! Or is this just surprise and excitement?

WTF!? Fucking imposter Ami stabs real Nodoka!
THIS CAN'T BE HAPPENING RIGHT NOW!!! NO NO NO NO NO NO!
IS THAT what Nodoka meant by getting a new shirt!? I thought that was a fucking SEX JOKE!

And OF COURSE we get to see that Maya event now! It wasn't fucking enough was it!? Seeing a clone get rape. You had to kill an actual person from the main timeline in a brutal way, not just a poof.

Great. So apparently there's more than one original Maya. Apparently there may be tons of them as well if I understand this correctly.

Nothing feels right anymore. Playing this game was a mistake and I'm holding everyone responsible who didn't have the heart to warn me on day one when I asked very specific questions. One of them being if a character dies and I got really vague answers. So if Nodoka didn't fucking die there, then I don't know what counts as death in the first place. And if Maya didn't technically die, then what? You can't just dance around the idea of death when it very clearly IS death and it WILL affect you over a long period of time. You had the power to warn me, you wanted me to suffer instead. Are you happy with yourself?

I'm so confused. Which Ami is this? Is this the present day Ami? Is Makoto just dead too?

If Ami is portrayed as being this God and ruler of the world or whatever the fuck she makes herself seem as. THEN WHAT IS THE POINT OF THIS GAME BUT TO WASTE OUR TIME?

It didn't even fucking occur to me when I saw that 0.45 picture after everyone went poof that Ami's tendencies had just been triggered. Sure I saw that after I knew it was coming, but how the fuck was I suppose to predict a murder!?

I have never held my breath for too long or been forced into that position, but if I had, I would probably be screaming right now.

Why am I not surprised. Both Ami and Maya dies again.

The human body is resilient... question is, can this game break my mind enough to make me immune to this shit irl? Because that sure would be a nice bonus because bad emotions are... well, bad. But being resilient means you won't change. I've seen horrible shit, some things have desensitized me, but some things hurts every time. How many times do I have to see beloved fictional characters die and characters get ntr raped before I stop feeling that pain? Because it sure as fuck would be nice if I stopped feeling that so I stop having to ask people if the games include that and STILL not get a proper answer! Yes, I'm going to be salty about that forever!

This image also looks familiar. Probably on a banner or something. Ayane and Maya walking outside in their bunny themed costumes with text on the side.

4 is an unlucky number in Japan. It's associated with death. Do you think this was an intentional move by the dev? We have experienced 2 very clear deaths at this point and several implied. That's at least 2 more than in past chapters.

Generic hyped reaction seeing Yumi is still fine after the encounter with Kaori. Should have guessed since Nodoka "survived" hers... man, I don't see the point in getting attached to anyone anymore. Just zone out, accept what happens and move on. The dev went too far, I can't be bothered to react anymore. But that will probably age poorly.
Man... but I will miss so much fun and adrenaline if I do that. I will just fall asleep. But maybe that's what I need to grow bored of the game, because I won't let myself have fun playing it, so I will subconsciously think it's boring and move on.
...
The coming few weeks will determine if I will come back to this game after 0.47.
I will probably download the latest version and unlock the gallery tho. The more spoilers I get, the less exciting it will be to play. Destroy any incentive to come back. Move on from this nightmare.
I'm so conflicted... Part of me wants to just quit and never look back. Another of me wants to quit and only check out the updated gallery. Another wants to play with emotions turned off. And the last wants to play the game like normal and just stomach the pain.
Why should I not quit? I mean, this game is ruining my sleep schedule, making me angry, sad, stressed and worried constantly. The sex scenes aren't save worthy and my mental abilities can't quite keep up with the game as I either forget or fail to concentrate. It's also consuming too much time and distracting me from what I could be doing instead. If there is any right time to quit, it's now.
I've already regretted playing the game, but now I regret it again. And it will be a never ending cycle of pain and suffering. This game was built to make you suffer.
In a roundabout way, I get it now. I get why so many people just give up on love entirely. Maybe that's the true message of "lesson's in love". To make you suffer so much that you either give up half way, or stomach it all and get a happy ending. But happy endings are also sad, because that's when the story ends. Why should you suffer for so long and have all the good things undone if the benefits don't even come close to making up for it? I really don't know what to say anymore about this. And I'm not sure the reactions after this will be worthwhile.

Generic surprised funny reaction to Maya saying she's had a threesome with everyone in class. Yey... who cares.

Oh, I forgot about that. Kaori and Yumi are cousins. Panicked for nothing back there.

Ahh, I know what I can do. I can enable Unseen text and just fucking skip everything! There we go. That should do the trick.

What a weird looking Yumi. I would be laughing. IF I ACTUALLY CARED!

And hope is named peerless god of light. I don't know why, because I'm not currently reading because fuck you I don't care anymore.

So many wonderful things to see, so many wonderful reactions. Am I ruining it for myself by skipping ahead? Yes. Do I regret it? Hmmm, no. This has to be done.

Huh, I guess Chika and Rin got back together... at least visually. Good for them.

Nodoka cosplaying Ami is funny.

Well, I'm "caught up" to version 0.47 end now. But saying that would imply I actually read anything, which I most assuredly did not. I just saw things moving in rapid speed, I don't know what the point was behind that but it's a thing that happened. So we will see if I come back later. I probably skipped through like 2 days of reading or something.

Maybe I can be talked back into actually reading through everything that happens after Yumi shows up next to Ayane and Maya as long as nothing too bad happens. But I think it would be best if I didn't play for a while. Get my mind off things, forget about this game and just get second hand feedback to determine if it's worth playing again.

I don't fucking know dude... Feels like 73 days just went down the drain and it doesn't help that I got impatient near the end. I don't know if I would even consider it impatience. If you would, it would stem fromt he idea that I can't keep putting myself through this. I don't want to see this shit and I'm tired of having to suffer.

So yeah. Goodbye I guess. Will still be replying to things after this post for a while once I cleared my head for some hours.

And if you asked me today if I regret playing this game, I would tell you I would rather jump off a skyscraper than play this. Fuck this abomination of a trauma fest. I wouldn't recommend this to my worst enemy.

You will probably see me post in Eternum's forum next and some other games.

And please. Don't subject other players to this if they go out of their way to ask the community before they get started about specific traumatizing things. For example, I asked if characters die in the game inducing trauma on you, I got a vague answer that wasn't satisfactory at all. You can laugh all you want at my weakness, but yeah. I've never been emotionally hurt so many times and actually wholeheartedly regretted the experience despite having what I refer to as "an iron stomach".

Great. So apparently there's more than one original Maya. Apparently there may be tons of them as well if I understand this correctly.

Nothing feels right anymore. Playing this game was a mistake and I'm holding everyone responsible who didn't have the heart to warn me on day one when I asked very specific questions. One of them being if a character dies and I got really vague answers. So if Nodoka didn't fucking die there, then I don't know what counts as death in the first place. If Ami is portrayed as being this God and ruler of the world or whatever the fuck she makes herself seem as. THEN WHAT IS THE POINT OF THIS GAME BUT TO WASTE OUR TIME?

I have never held my breath for too long or been forced into that position, but if I had, I would probably be screaming right now.

Why am I not surprised. Both Ami and Maya dies again.

The human body is resilient... question is, can this game break my mind enough to make me immune to this shit irl? Because that sure would be a nice bonus because bad emotions are... well, bad. How many times do I have to see beloved fictional characters die and characters get ntr raped before I stop feeling that pain? Ahh, I know what I can do. I can enable Unseen text and just fucking skip everything! There we go. That should do the trick.

What a weird looking Yumi. I would be laughing. IF I ACTUALLY CARED!

And hope is named peerless god of light. I don't know why, because I'm not currently reading because fuck you I don't care anymore.

Huh, I guess Chika and Rin got back together... at least visually. Good for them.

Nodoka cosplaying Ami is funny.

I probably skipped through like 2 days of reading or something.

I feel like all Maya really was was an endless sea of memories and experiences. That's probably why her disappearance hit me so badly. Nodoka - "Is something wrong? You look like you've just seen a ghost."
- "Do I need a reason to want to look my best for a reunion with my beloved?"
- "There's no need, Otoha. I was actually just leaving."
- "And my job is already done. I'm so good at this."
Sensei - "Are you okay?"
Nodoka - "Never better."
(Chapter 4 Otoha 'Sisterly Love' Event)


To be fair, "our" Nodoka was in a different Nodoka's body. That Nodoka was probably fucked. Ours may have "survived" mentally, albeit it's not entirely clear.

Nodoka seems a little off, but that may just be expected after what happened to her. Then again, Nodoka may have just left enough clues for Current Nodoka to piece things together, to simulate "survival". Hard to say.

For example, besides Otoha and Futaba seeming to think Nodoka's been acting strange, Nodoka looking her best (as she claimed) would possibly include her glasses. She's self-conscious without them:
Nodoka - "I'm starting to feel a little self-conscious, actually. I don't think I'm very pretty without my glasses on."
(Chapter 2 Nodoka 'I See Everything' Event)
Also, I'm not sure if Nodoka is still pregnant or not, or if she even actually was. I'd still think it'd be something she'd mention. Although, she may have just dealt with it like Ayane did.

I'm pretty sure we got a narrator Tsubasa appearance in 0.47, and for the second time she showed an unusual amount of interest in Rin, even speaking to her directly. This got me wondering if there is a link between Rin and actual Tsubasa.

Here's a speculative idea: one of Rin's moms (probably Rika) was friends with Tsubasa in their youth. In fact, I found a hint of this that's been in the game for a while: one of the very few pieces of information that we've been given about Tsubasa's friend(s) matches something we know about Rin's mom(s).
When she was in high school, Tsubasa used to sneak away from her strict family to have "wild" experiences with a group of girlfriends. I suggested before that one of those friends was Chiaki, and others have suggested Sekai.
Tsubasa said that one of her girlfriends introduced her to the idea of throwing a child into a pool to force them to swim.
This is also how Rin's mom attempted to teach her to swim.

The "foster mom" part is weird, but elsewhere ("The Art of Never Knowing") she implies that it was her adoptive parents. I guess they fostered her first.

Being forced to swim is widely used as a metaphor in the game, and in fact Tsubasa is using it to describe Touka and Sensei's upcoming relationship, but there was no reason for Selebus to insert the info that the story is literally true for Tsubasa's friend. Rin is the only other person that the story is literally true for. I don't think Selebus would have two characters have identical experiences as sheer coincidence, so I think the two stories are connected.

My speculation is that Rin's mom learned to swim by this method and, since it was effective for her, she both told her friend Tsubasa about it and tried to use it with her own daughter. As for which mom, Rika seems more likely than Rie to have "wild" youthful experiences and engage in irresponsible parenting. On the other hand, given Rie's conservative upbringing it's possible she attended the same prestigious girls' academy as Tsubasa.

Of course, Rika would have no reason to keep an old relationship with Tsubasa secret, so it would be revealed as soon as we saw the two meet - but I'm almost positive that they've yet to appear in a scene together.

I also like the idea that Rika and Chiaki were part of the same friend group but Rika is too thick to connect Chiaki and Chika as two bleach blonde Filipinos whose names starts Chi-. After all, this is the woman who:
  • Came to the conclusion that S.A. Nagahara just happened to look extremely similar to Nodoka and didn't consider the idea that her book was about the class.
  • Didn't consider (until seeing her picture) the possibility that the awkwardly horny girl named Rin who was sexting Sensei was Sensei's awkwardly horny student named Rin.
I think Rin's events in the 0.47 update are narrated by "narrator Tsubasa". The usual disclaimer here: while I think the narrator is Tsubasa, all we know for certain is that Tsubasa has directly quoted them and they have very similar worldviews. If the narrator isn't Tsubasa it's likely that they are directly influencing her.

If this is narrator Tsubasa, it's the second time that she's showed an unusual amount of interest in Rin. The first time was during the first beach trip, which I originally attributed to the connection to Chika (all of those events centered on Rin's confession). But now that she's done it again and seems more focused on Rin's relationship with Sensei this time, it got me thinking that there was a more direct connection. And if Tsubasa's interest in Chika originates from knowing Chiaki, maybe her interest in Rin comes from a similar place.

Anyway, here's why I think it's narrator Tsubasa:

She (0.47 narrator) starts by being melancholic about how she has stopped forming happy memories as she's gotten older. In her first appearance narrator Tsubasa also regretted the passing of the happier days of her youth, and Tsubasa herself has expressed similar sentiments on multiple occasions.
"Voice of Reason":

"Cursed Birds":

"Bleed":

"Red-ish Light District":
She talks about how she has often deceived Sensei and/or the reader (see first screenshot above this), something that Tsubasa is known for.
"You & Me Against the World":


"The Pleasures of the Flesh":
She speaks directly to Rin, reprimanding her for being too timid and goading her to make a move on Sensei.
It's extremely rare for a narrator to speak to one of the girls directly; in fact, while I'm probably forgetting some, the only other case I can remember is when narrator Tsubasa spoke to Rin during the first beach trip.
The 0.47 narrator wants Rin to drown herself in the wishing well and be decisive about pursuing Sensei. The beach narrator also talked about drowning, the wishing well, and taking what you want.
"See You in the Morning":

At the beach, it seems like Rin might have heard the narrator. If she's hearing the narrator again, that might be the "dark entity" that is influencing her horniness for Sensei.

Whenever there's an ending to the loops, there's a chance every death that's happened after the loops started is likely to be reset.

But as far as any of the main cast, any death that could happen just doesn't have stakes. Sensei's implied to have been reset an almost infinite amount of times so he's likely died before. The main cast has had an example of suicide being prevented so death isn't going to last. And the only other people who don't seem to follow the rules (Ami and Maya) have either died or reset while we've seen it, so death is no longer as huge a problem without the lasting consequences of it.
As the relevant example, when Nodoka died on update release day, no one here was mourning her death. It was a big oh shit moment, and then a lot of people honoring her and taking her off their shit lists. Gruesome thing that a lot of people didn't want to happen of course, but people seemed to understand it as something that could feasibly happen because those are the stakes with a world like this. (remember chika was going crazy here, she just saw sensei and yumi at the beach)

It sounds like you aren't giving the game up now that you've had a night to decompress. Everything else in the post is best forgotten until you read it then. If you were gonna drop the game until a lot of updates later, after 0.48's release would be a great time for it.

aramaug said:
I'm pretty sure we got a narrator Tsubasa appearance in 0.47, and for the second time she showed an unusual amount of interest in Rin, even speaking to her directly. This got me wondering if there is a link between Rin and actual Tsubasa.

Here's a speculative idea: one of Rin's moms (probably Rika) was friends with Tsubasa in their youth. In fact, I found a hint of this that's been in the game for a while: one of the very few pieces of information that we've been given about Tsubasa's friend(s) matches something we know about Rin's mom(s).
When she was in high school, Tsubasa used to sneak away from her strict family to have "wild" experiences with a group of girlfriends. I suggested before that one of those friends was Chiaki, and others have suggested Sekai.
View attachment 4585110 View attachment 4585115
Tsubasa said that one of her girlfriends introduced her to the idea of throwing a child into a pool to force them to swim.
View attachment 4585120 View attachment 4585123
This is also how Rin's mom attempted to teach her to swim.
View attachment 4585124 View attachment 4585126
The "foster mom" part is weird, but elsewhere ("The Art of Never Knowing") she implies that it was her adoptive parents. I guess they fostered her first.
View attachment 4585127
View attachment 4585129
Being forced to swim is widely used as a metaphor in the game, and in fact Tsubasa is using it to describe Touka and Sensei's upcoming relationship, but there was no reason for Selebus to insert the info that the story is literally true for Tsubasa's friend. Rin is the only other person that the story is literally true for. I don't think Selebus would have two characters have identical experiences as sheer coincidence, so I think the two stories are connected.

My speculation is that Rin's mom learned to swim by this method and, since it was effective for her, she both told her friend Tsubasa about it and tried to use it with her own daughter. As for which mom, Rika seems more likely than Rie to have "wild" youthful experiences and engage in irresponsible parenting. On the other hand, given Rie's conservative upbringing it's possible she attended the same prestigious girls' academy as Tsubasa.

Of course, Rika would have no reason to keep an old relationship with Tsubasa secret, so it would be revealed as soon as we saw the two meet - but I'm almost positive that they've yet to appear in a scene together.

I also like the idea that Rika and Chiaki were part of the same friend group but Rika is too thick to connect Chiaki and Chika as two bleach blonde Filipinos whose names starts Chi-. After all, this is the woman who:
  • Came to the conclusion that S.A. Nagahara just happened to look extremely similar to Nodoka and didn't consider the idea that her book was about the class.
  • Didn't consider (until seeing her picture) the possibility that the awkwardly horny girl named Rin who was sexting Sensei was Sensei's awkwardly horny student named Rin.
I think Rin's events in the 0.47 update are narrated by "narrator Tsubasa". The usual disclaimer here: while I think the narrator is Tsubasa, all we know for certain is that Tsubasa has directly quoted them and they have very similar worldviews. If the narrator isn't Tsubasa it's likely that they are directly influencing her.

If this is narrator Tsubasa, it's the second time that she's showed an unusual amount of interest in Rin. The first time was during the first beach trip, which I originally attributed to the connection to Chika (all of those events centered on Rin's confession). But now that she's done it again and seems more focused on Rin's relationship with Sensei this time, it got me thinking that there was a more direct connection. And if Tsubasa's interest in Chika originates from knowing Chiaki, maybe her interest in Rin comes from a similar place.

Anyway, here's why I think it's narrator Tsubasa:

She (0.47 narrator) starts by being melancholic about how she has stopped forming happy memories as she's gotten older. In her first appearance narrator Tsubasa also regretted the passing of the happier days of her youth, and Tsubasa herself has expressed similar sentiments on multiple occasions.
